title_translated: 跨模型上下文神经反馈揭示大语言模型中（有限的）激活控制能力
summary_translated: 对激活向量的探测广泛用于检测语言模型中的异常行为，但这依赖于模型无法控制其激活编码内容的假设。人类可通过神经反馈学会控制单个神经元的放电，近期研究探讨这种能力是否适用于语言模型，但结论相互矛盾。迄今为止，尚无实验设计能区分任务能力与对自身激活的真实访问能力。我们通过上下文神经反馈会话填补这一空白，其中“主体”模型被要求最大化（或最小化）一个源自其激活的得分，并在每一轮将其反馈给自身。在首次实验中，句子由主体或第二个“写作者”模型生成，但得分始终来自主体的激活。我们测试了来自五个系列的十款开源权重模型，规模从9B到32B。部分模型能显著改变自身得分，但程度不超过同等能力的写作者。这是由于任务本身无需特权访问，还是因为主体在处理句子时（无论谁撰写）都能控制其激活？为回答此问题，我们在每轮预填充固定句子作为主体回复，并要求其提高或降低得分。十款模型中有三款表现出微小但稳定的控制效应。我们进一步探究模型能否控制激活以欺骗激活监控器。我们让模型重复监控器会标记的句子，例如欺骗性回答，要求其提高或降低监控器的得分。没有模型学会降低得分，但有一款模型能提高它。上下文对自身激活的控制可能尚未构成对激活监控器的重大威胁，但在少数模型中已存在，随着模型演进需持续关注。

summary: Parallel drafters such as DFlash and DSpark reduce proposal latency, but early mismatches limit how much of each block can be accepted. Retaining alternatives introduces parent states and candidate choices that reference-conditioned training does not directly supervise. We introduce TreeSpark, a unified training and inference framework extending the semi-autoregressive DSpark architecture. It constructs parent-conditioned candidate trees from one backbone pass and replays their expansion, pruning, and budgeted packing during training. Survival negative log-likelihood weights retained edges by reference-derived path mass, while a capped coverage hinge promotes target-important alternatives near local selection boundaries. Both objectives reuse reference-chain target distributions without additional target forward passes. We evaluate greedy decoding with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B on nine general benchmarks and six writing domains. Across targets and suites, TreeSpark improves mean acceptance length over DSpark by 23.4% to 31.6% and mean single-request throughput by 15.1% to 25.0%. Batched Qwen3-4B throughput improves by 12.6% to 17.2%. At fixed attention capacity and inference policy, the proposed supervision further improves mean acceptance length by approximately 6.4% and mean system throughput by 4.2% to 5.0% on Qwen3-4B.
title: TreeSpark: Learning to Draft the Trees You Verify for Speculative Decoding
title_translated: TreeSpark：学习为推测解码所验证的树结构进行草稿生成
summary_translated: 并行草稿生成器如DFlash和DSpark可减少提案延迟，但早期不匹配限制了每块可接受的内容量。保留备选方案引入了父状态和候选选择，而这些是参考条件训练无法直接监督的。我们提出TreeSpark，一种统一的训练与推理框架，扩展了半自回归的DSpark架构。它通过一次主干网络遍历构建父条件候选树，并在训练过程中重放其扩展、剪枝和预算打包过程。生存负对数似然通过参考导出路径质量来加权保留边，而截断覆盖铰链则促进在局部选择边界附近的重要备选方案。两个目标均复用参考链目标分布，无需额外的目标前向传播。我们在九个通用基准和六个写作领域上评估了贪心解码下的Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B。在各类目标和套件中，TreeSpark相比DSpark将平均接受长度提升了23.4%至31.6%，平均单请求吞吐量提升15.1%至25.0%。批量Qwen3-4B吞吐量提升12.6%至17.2%。在固定注意力容量和推理策略下，所提出的监督进一步将Qwen3-4B的平均接受长度提升约6.4%，系统吞吐量提升4.2%至5.0%。

summary: Language models often produce semantically similar answers to open-ended questions, even when many plausible alternatives exist. Generating useful alternatives requires identifying both what the query calls for and what existing responses already cover. We introduce Gap Detection, a framework that searches for relevant but unoccupied directions in a shared text embedding space. Its objective, GapScore, combines query relevance (Demand) with dissimilarity to the nearest existing item (Defensibility). The framework optimizes this product on the unit sphere, maps candidate directions to concept words with a language model, and uses task-specific filtering and constrained prompting to turn those concepts into text. On five curated topics and 90 INFINITY-CHAT queries, the reported mean relative reductions in output Collision are 12.8% and 10.8%, respectively. We also instantiate the framework for generative engine optimization over four product markets and for iterative synthetic-data augmentation. In the latter setting, with 100 training examples per method, Gap Detection reduces Collision from 0.324 to 0.298 relative to undirected accumulation and increases the Vendi Score from 27.16 to 29.20; the accuracy difference is one example on a 40-example test set. Component ablations expose the trade-off between semantic separation and relevance, while also showing that better direction scores do not uniformly yield better downstream metrics. These results support explicit gap search as a practical mechanism for diversifying content, with task validity checked separately from geometric novelty.
title: Gap Detection: Mitigating Homogenization through Demand and Defensibility
comment: 24 pages; submitted to ICLR 2027, under review
title_translated: 缺口检测：通过需求与防御性缓解同质化
summary_translated: 语言模型在面对开放式问题时常产生语义相似的回答，即使存在许多合理的替代答案。生成有用的替代答案需要同时识别查询所需的内容以及现有回答已覆盖的部分。我们提出缺口检测（Gap Detection）框架，该框架在共享文本嵌入空间中搜索相关但未被占据的方向。其目标函数GapScore结合了查询相关性（需求）与最近已有项的差异性（防御性）。该框架在单位球面上优化这一乘积，利用语言模型将候选方向映射为概念词，并通过特定任务过滤和约束提示将这些概念转化为文本。在五个精选主题和90个INFINITY-CHAT查询上，报告的输出碰撞率相对减少分别为12.8%和10.8%。我们还将该框架应用于四个产品市场的生成引擎优化及迭代合成数据增强。在后者设置中，每种方法使用100个训练样本，Gap Detection将碰撞率从0.324降至0.298（相对于无方向积累），Vendi得分从27.16提升至29.20；准确率差异在40个样本测试集中体现为一个例子。组件消融实验揭示了语义分离与相关性之间的权衡，同时也表明更好的方向得分并不总是带来更优的下游指标。这些结果支持显式缺口搜索作为一种实用的内容多样化机制，其任务有效性可独立于几何新颖性进行验证。

summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have emerged as a promising approach to mechanistic interpretability by decomposing language-model activations into sparse, potentially interpretable features. However, differences in design assumptions, evaluation objectives, and experimental settings complicate conclusions about their effectiveness. We present a critical survey of 138 studies on SAEs in natural language processing. Our contributions are fourfold: (1) we propose a task-grounded taxonomy connecting dictionary design, feature operations, and NLP functions; (2) we examine how sparsity allocation, geometry, data coverage, and inference affect feature recoverability; (3) we assess evidence for semantic interpretability, mechanistic faithfulness, and behavioral utility; and (4) we synthesize findings across multilingual processing, retrieval, reasoning, classification, and behavioral regulation, highlighting the roles of objectives, baselines, supervision, and intervention pipelines. Through comparative analyses of published results, we reconcile apparent disagreements, identify unresolved questions, and propose directions for more rigorous evaluation. An anonymous research register https://anonymous.4open.science/r/sae-research-register-C331/register.html accompanies the survey.
title: Sparse Autoencoders for Mechanistic Interpretability in NLP: A Critical Survey of Recoverability, Interpretability, and Utility
title_translated: 用于自然语言处理机制可解释性的稀疏自编码器：可恢复性、可解释性与实用性的批判性综述
summary_translated: 稀疏自编码器（SAEs）通过将语言模型的激活分解为稀疏且可能具有可解释性的特征，已成为一种有前景的机制可解释性方法。然而，设计假设、评估目标和实验设置的差异使得对其有效性的结论变得复杂。我们对138篇关于自然语言处理中SAEs的研究进行了批判性综述。我们的贡献包括四方面：(1) 提出一个基于任务的分类体系，连接词典设计、特征操作与NLP功能；(2) 探讨稀疏度分配、几何结构、数据覆盖范围和推理对特征可恢复性的影响；(3) 评估语义可解释性、机制忠实性和行为实用性的证据；(4) 综合多语言处理、检索、推理、分类和行为调控中的发现，突出目标、基线、监督和干预流程的作用。通过对比分析已发表结果，我们调和了表面矛盾，识别出未解决的问题，并提出了更严格评估的方向。一份匿名研究注册表 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/sae-research-register-C331/register.html 随附该综述。

summary: Web agents built on vision language models decide every action by generating text such as click(12), although most of that text encodes a choice among a few action types and a few dozen marked elements. We read these choices directly from the hidden states that the generator computes while it reads the goal and the screenshot. Plug-in decision heads on a frozen generator predict the action type, pool the visual tokens inside each numbered box to pick the target, and point at a listed text option or at a WRITE slot that leaves the writing of new text to the generator. A confidence cascade executes the heads' action when they are sure and otherwise lets the generator decode from the KV cache of the same forward pass. With Qwen3-VL 4B and 8B generators trained on 213k web steps, a strict threshold keeps the cascade between 0.3 points below and 1.4 points above the generator on seven offline test sets while the heads decide 12 to 64% of the steps. A looser threshold raises step success on unseen Mind2Web websites by 3.1 and 1.8 points, costs up to 2 points on GUIAct and MiniWoB++, and lifts WebArena task success from 12.5 to 13.8% (4B) and from 13.6 to 14.6% (8B) with less than half of the generated tokens. Training the heads jointly with the generator lowers the generator's own step success by up to 4.9 points; heads on a frozen generator avoid this cost.
title: Why Generate a Click? Plug-in Decision Heads for Web Agents
title_translated: 为何要生成一次点击？面向网页智能体的插件式决策头
summary_translated: 基于视觉-语言模型构建的网页智能体通过生成文本（如click(12)）来决定每个动作，但这些文本大多仅编码少数动作类型和数十个标记元素之间的选择。我们直接从生成器在读取目标和截图时计算的隐藏状态中读取这些选择。在冻结生成器上部署的插件式决策头可预测动作类型，对每个编号框内的视觉标记进行聚合以选择目标，并指向列出的文本选项或WRITE槽位，由生成器负责新文本的书写。置信度级联机制在决策头确定时执行其动作，否则让生成器从同一前向传播的KV缓存中解码。使用Qwen3-VL 4B和8B生成器在21.3万步网页数据上训练，严格阈值使级联性能在七个离线测试集上保持在生成器性能0.3点以下至1.4点以上，同时决策头负责12%至64%的动作步骤。宽松阈值使未见过的Mind2Web网站成功率提升3.1和1.8点，在GUIAct和MiniWoB++上最多损失2点，同时将WebArena任务成功率从12.5%提升至13.8%（4B）和从13.6%提升至14.6%（8B），且生成token少于一半。与生成器联合训练决策头会使生成器自身步骤成功率下降最多4.9点；而使用冻结生成器的决策头则避免了这一代价。

summary: We investigate two aspects of multilingual pre-training with limited data, namely how language exposure is distributed across English, Dutch, and Chinese, and how that exposure is ordered during training. In particular, we compare balanced multilingual exposure to language-dominant exposure, where one language is exposed with more training data than the others. We also compare mixed training, where multilingual training data is used throughout training, with curriculum training, where monolingual exposure of the dominant language is followed by balanced multilingual exposure. Our results show that multilingual BabyLM performance varies with both the amount and order of language exposure. Mixed training outperforms curriculum learning across all 15 matched configurations, indicating that simultaneous multilingual exposure is more effective than staged exposure in our setting. Several language-dominant mixed training configurations achieve higher scores than the balanced configuration, suggesting that a balanced distribution is not necessarily the highest-performing configuration in our setting. Interestingly, the Dutch-primary configurations achieve the best overall performance.
title: Language Exposure Matters: Distribution and Order in Multilingual BabyLM Pre-training
title_translated: 语言暴露至关重要：多语言BabyLM预训练中的分布与顺序
summary_translated: 我们研究了在有限数据条件下进行多语言预训练的两个方面：即英语、荷兰语和中文的语言暴露如何分布，以及训练过程中这种暴露的顺序。具体而言，我们比较了平衡多语言暴露与语言主导型暴露（其中一种语言使用更多训练数据）的差异，还比较了全程混合训练与课程学习（先进行主导语言的单语暴露，再进入平衡多语言暴露）的差异。结果表明，多语言BabyLM的表现随语言暴露的数量和顺序而变化。在所有15组匹配配置中，混合训练均优于课程学习，表明在本设置下同时进行多语言暴露比分阶段暴露更有效。多个语言主导型混合训练配置得分高于平衡配置，说明在本设置中平衡分布并非最优配置。有趣的是，以荷兰语为主导的配置取得了最佳整体表现。

summary: Synthetic data is increasingly used in language-model pretraining. Existing knowledge-corpus synthesis pipelines, including WRAP and Nemotron-CC, usually take a source passage or document segment as input and generate rewritten or QA-style samples from that text. This can improve surface form and prompt diversity, but it does not explicitly require fine-grained source facts -- especially secondary entities, list/table entries, and precise temporal attributes -- to appear in the synthesized corpus. We propose AFCS (Atomic-Fact-Conditioned Synthesis), a pipeline that first extracts source-supported atomic facts and then uses each retained fact to drive generation. AFCS uses structure-aware extraction over the document tree, source-grounded verification, local context expansion, and multi-format generation. In continued-pretraining experiments with OLMo-3-7B and a 32B base on the same FineWiki source corpus, AFCS outperforms WRAP and Nemotron-CC on SimpleQA, SimpleQA Verified, PopQA, and HotpotQA. Granularity ablations show that fact-level synthesis improves over chunk-level, paragraph-level, and entity-level synthesis; and a 100B-token mid-training integration improves factual benchmarks and raises the 12-task general benchmark average by +1.09.
title: AFCS: Atomic-Fact-Conditioned Synthesis for Factual Knowledge Pretraining
title_translated: AFCS：原子事实条件合成用于事实知识预训练
summary_translated: 合成数据在语言模型预训练中的应用日益广泛。现有的知识语料库合成流程（包括WRAP和Nemotron-CC）通常以源段落或文档片段为输入，从中生成重写或问答样例。这虽能提升表面形式和提示多样性，但并未明确要求细粒度的源事实——尤其是次要实体、列表/表格条目和精确的时间属性——出现在合成语料库中。我们提出AFCS（原子事实条件合成）流程，首先提取受源支持的原子事实，然后利用每个保留的事实驱动生成过程。AFCS采用结构感知提取、基于源的验证、局部上下文扩展和多格式生成。在OLMo-3-7B和32B基础模型上使用相同FineWiki源语料库进行持续预训练的实验表明，AFCS在SimpleQA、SimpleQA Verified、PopQA和HotpotQA上优于WRAP和Nemotron-CC。粒度消融实验显示，事实级合成优于块级、段落级和实体级合成；在训练中期整合100B token的合成数据可提升事实基准表现，并使12项通用基准平均分提高+1.09。

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently encounter conflicts between internal parametric knowledge and external contextual knowledge, yet the mechanisms governing this selection remain unclear. We show that the choice between context and parametric knowledge is linearly represented and can be controlled along a single direction in the model's residual stream. We first demonstrate that this direction generalizes across factual-conflict settings, including context formats, knowledge categories, and datasets, while consistently shifting behavior between parametric and contextual answers. We then transfer a direction learned from simple factual conflicts to three more complex task families: RAG, memory, and rule following, where models must acquire information from retrieved documents, interaction histories, or explicit rules. Across four model families and multiple transfer settings, steering consistently improves the use of prompt-provided information over the unsteered model. These results suggest that the direction captures a transferable preference for external knowledge rather than a mechanism specific to factual conflicts.
title: Which Knowledge Should LLMs Trust? Uncovering a Generalizable Steering Direction Across Knowledge Conflicts
title_translated: 大语言模型应信任哪些知识？在知识冲突中揭示一种可泛化的引导方向
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）经常面临内部参数化知识与外部上下文知识之间的冲突，但其选择机制仍不清晰。我们发现，上下文与参数化知识之间的选择在线性上表示，并可在模型残差流中沿单一方向进行控制。我们首先证明该方向在多种事实冲突场景中具有泛化能力，包括不同上下文格式、知识类别和数据集，且能一致地在参数化答案与上下文答案之间切换行为。随后，我们将从简单事实冲突中学到的方向迁移至三个更复杂的任务族：RAG、记忆和规则遵循，其中模型需从检索文档、交互历史或显式规则中获取信息。在四个模型家族和多个迁移设置中，引导均显著提升了模型对提示所提供信息的利用效率，优于未引导模型。这些结果表明，该方向捕捉的是对外部知识的可迁移偏好，而非仅限于事实冲突的特定机制。

summary: Ambiguous inputs can admit multiple interpretations, each potentially yielding a different answer. Existing work largely treats this ambiguity as a property of the input, yet for a particular language model, only some alternatives may be known and answerable. We therefore distinguish world ambiguity, capturing all alternatives admitted by an input, from model ambiguity, capturing those accessible to the responding model. To characterize these alternatives, we formalize natural-language clarifications through three desiderata: \emph{uniqueness}, \emph{faithfulness}, and \emph{answer equivalence}. We show that these desiderata induce a one-to-one correspondence between valid answers and equivalence classes of clarifications, implying that any interpretation can be represented either by its answer or by the clarifications that uniquely express it. We leverage this correspondence to introduce \circleclar{}, a black-box method that estimates the set of answers available to a model by checking consistency along an answer--clarification--answer cycle. Across open-domain QA and executable Text-to-SQL, \circleclar{} achieves strong recovery of these answer sets. In QA, the recovered support yields the strongest overall performance in model-dependent ambiguity detection and enables effective selection among answering, clarifying, and abstaining. Together, these results demonstrate the practical value of a model-dependent view of ambiguity and its characterization through an answer-clarification correspondence.
title: What Is a Clarification? Estimating Model-Dependent Input Ambiguity
comment: Outstanding Paper Award and Oral Presentation at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Linguistic Principles for Foundation Models (LP4FM)
title_translated: 什么是澄清？估计模型相关的输入模糊性
summary_translated: 模糊的输入可能有多种解释，每种解释都可能导致不同的答案。现有研究大多将这种模糊性视为输入本身的属性，但对于特定的语言模型而言，只有部分替代解释是已知且可回答的。因此，我们区分了世界模糊性（捕获输入所允许的所有替代解释）和模型模糊性（捕获响应模型可访问的那些解释）。为了刻画这些替代解释，我们通过三个理想标准形式化自然语言澄清：唯一性、忠实性和答案等价性。我们证明这些标准在有效答案与澄清等价类之间建立了一一对应关系，这意味着任何解释都可以通过其答案或唯一表达它的澄清来表示。我们利用这一对应关系提出 	extcircled{clar}{}，一种黑盒方法，通过检查答案-澄清-答案循环中的一致性来估计模型可获得的答案集合。在开放域问答和可执行的文本转SQL任务中，	extcircled{clar}{} 能够有效恢复这些答案集。在问答任务中，恢复的支持信息实现了最强的模型相关模糊性检测性能，并能有效选择回答、澄清或放弃。这些结果共同展示了模型相关模糊性视角及其通过答案-澄清对应关系表征的实际价值。

summary: In recent years, with advances in multimodal interaction technologies and the growing demand for intelligent emotional support, Multimodal Emotional Support Conversation (MESC) has emerged as an important task. However, existing systems still suffer from shallow responses and inappropriate support strategies due to weak semantic feedback, cross-dimension reward compensation, and coarse reasoning supervision. To address these challenges, we propose FACES, a fine-grained gated semantic alignment framework for MESC. Specifically, FACES integrates multi-source rewards to construct multidimensional semantic and functional alignment signals, employs a non-compensatory gated fusion mechanism to reduce cross-dimension reward offset, and leverages structured Chain-of-Thought (CoT) anchors to perform token-level credit assignment. Under a controlled response-length protocol, FACES improves the average MLLM-based evaluation score from 3.61 to 4.04 and achieves an 80.22% pairwise win rate over SOTA. Human evaluation under the same protocol yields a 75.3% preference rate. Results on three external datasets further support transferability. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/OCT-ARR/arr.
title: FACES: Fine-grained Gated Semantic Alignment for Multimodal Emotional Support Conversation
title_translated: FACES：用于多模态情感支持对话的细粒度门控语义对齐
summary_translated: 近年来，随着多模态交互技术的进步以及对智能情感支持需求的增长，多模态情感支持对话（MESC）已成为一个重要任务。然而，现有系统仍因语义反馈薄弱、跨维度奖励补偿不足和粗粒度推理监督而存在回应浅显、支持策略不当的问题。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了 FACES，一种用于 MESC 的细粒度门控语义对齐框架。具体而言，FACES 集成多源奖励以构建多维语义与功能对齐信号，采用非补偿性门控融合机制减少跨维度奖励偏差，并利用结构化的思维链（CoT）锚点实现逐标记的信用分配。在控制响应长度的协议下，FACES 将基于 MLLM 的评估平均得分从 3.61 提升至 4.04，并在与 SOTA 方法的成对比较中取得 80.22% 的胜率。相同协议下的人工评估显示 75.3% 的偏好率。在三个外部数据集上的结果进一步验证了其可迁移性。代码与数据集可在 https://github.com/OCT-ARR/arr 获取。

summary: Legal-content reproduction requires matching the source exactly in section hierarchy, verbatim text, citations, and amendment spans; a dropped citation or mislabeled amendment carries into the products lawyers rely on. We report an industrial pipeline converting U.S. state legislation into strict, schema-constrained XML, and hypothesize that its accuracy comes from harness engineering, the deterministic tooling built around a model, more than the model itself. Our controlled ablation crosses three harnesses (zero-shot, a single tool-using agent, and a decomposed multi-agent pipeline) with three Claude models on 153 gold bills from two jurisdictions. The harness narrows the model gap: the weakest model in the full pipeline beats the strongest model alone (0.948 versus 0.806, paired bootstrap p less than 0.001). Because the two agentic harnesses share identical tools, their gap comes from orchestration: decomposition plus the persisted state and per-agent context it brings. Across four scored dimensions, the model spread at zero-shot (0.68 to 0.81) narrows to 0.95 at the full pipeline; the residual sits almost entirely in citation normalization, where the canonical identifier is retrieved from an external authority rather than generated from the weights, so a deterministic lookup tool supplies the exactness that a larger model does not.
title: A Strong Harness Narrows the Model Gap: A Comparative Evaluation for Legislative Document-to-XML Conversion
comment: Accepted to the Natural Legal Language Processing Workshop (NLLP) at EMNLP 2026
title_translated: 强大的工具链缩小了模型差距：立法文档到XML转换的对比评估
summary_translated: 法律内容的复现要求在章节层级、原文文本、引用和修订段落等方面与源文件完全一致；遗漏一个引用或错误标注的修订都会影响律师依赖的产品质量。我们报告了一个工业级管道，将美国各州立法文件转换为严格符合模式约束的 XML 格式，并假设其高精度源于工具链工程——围绕模型构建的确定性工具，而非模型本身。我们的受控消融实验在三个工具链（零样本、单个工具使用代理、分解式多代理流水线）与三种 Claude 模型之间进行，覆盖来自两个司法管辖区的 153 份真实法案。结果显示，工具链显著缩小了模型差距：最弱的模型在完整流水线中表现优于最强的独立模型（0.948 对比 0.806，配对 Bootstrap p < 0.001）。由于两种代理式工具链使用相同的工具，其差异源于编排方式：分解结构加上持久状态和每个代理的上下文信息。在四个评分维度上，零样本下的模型差异（0.68 到 0.81）缩小至流水线中的 0.95；残差几乎全部集中在引用归一化环节，该环节依赖外部权威机构获取规范标识符，而非由模型权重生成，因此确定性查找工具提供了大模型也无法提供的精确性。

summary: Large language models often produce fluent but factually incorrect output. Gray-box detectors identify such hallucinations from the token-probability statistics emitted during generation, avoiding the need for white-box access to hidden states that frontier models do not provide. These detectors, however, typically rely only on probability-derived representations and ignore the identities of the candidate tokens. They can therefore observe how uncertain the model is, but not what it is uncertain about. Consequently, they cannot distinguish between a model that is torn between "big" and "small" and one that is torn between "big" and "huge" when the two pairs receive the same probability distribution.   We introduce GURI (Gray-box Uncertainty Representations with Identity), a lightweight gray-box hallucination detector that combines candidate-token probabilities with per-token vector identifiers. This exposes which alternatives the model considered while preserving the accessibility and transferability of the gray-box setting. Across three open-weight models and three question-answering benchmarks, GURI increases mean test ROC-AUC from 72.09% to 79.09% over a probability-only baseline. On the closed-source GPT-4.1 model, mean ROC-AUC increases from 67.39% to 71.84%. Among the three open-weight models, GURI outperforms transferred probability-only baseline in 17 of 18 directed cross-model transfers without fine-tuning. For the three open-weight models, cross-dataset transfer between HotpotQA and TriviaQA with the model held fixed improves mean ROC-AUC over transferred LOS-Net by 3.76 points.
title: Gray-Box Hallucination Detection in LLMs with Token Identities
title_translated: 基于标记身份的灰盒幻觉检测在大语言模型中的应用
summary_translated: 大型语言模型经常生成流畅但事实错误的输出。灰盒检测器通过分析生成过程中产生的 token 概率统计来识别此类幻觉，避免了需要白盒访问隐藏状态（前沿模型通常不提供）。然而，这类检测器通常仅依赖概率衍生的表示，忽略了候选 token 的身份信息。因此，它们只能观察模型的不确定性程度，却无法判断模型在不确定什么。例如，当“big”与“small”和“big”与“huge”这两组词获得相同的概率分布时，检测器无法区分模型是在两者之间犹豫还是在后两者之间犹豫。我们提出 GURI（灰盒不确定性表示与身份结合），一种轻量级灰盒幻觉检测器，将候选 token 的概率与其各自的向量标识符相结合。这揭示了模型考虑过的备选方案，同时保持了灰盒设置的可访问性和可迁移性。在三个开源模型和三个问答基准测试中，GURI 将平均测试 ROC-AUC 从概率仅依赖基线的 72.09% 提升至 79.09%。在闭源 GPT-4.1 模型上，平均 ROC-AUC 从 67.39% 提升至 71.84%。在三个开源模型中，GURI 在 18 次定向跨模型迁移中无须微调即超越转移的概率仅依赖基线 17 次。对于三个开源模型，在固定模型条件下，从 HotpotQA 到 TriviaQA 的跨数据集迁移中，GURI 相较于转移的 LOS-Net 提升了 3.76 个百分点的平均 ROC-AUC。

summary: Law students are examined through open-text answers: case solutions, essays and memos that apply the law to a set of facts. Such answers are expensive to grade, human graders disagree widely on them, and large language models (LLMs) now offer to grade them at scale, both in teaching and in the benchmarks that test legal AI. This paper systematizes how open-text legal answers can be evaluated. We derive eight desiderata from educational measurement and from the law that governs exams, among them validity, reliability, reasons, credit for defensible alternative solutions, robustness to gaming and human oversight. We then compare eight evaluation paradigms against them, from unstructured human grading to LLM judges with instance-specific rubrics and pairwise comparison. Three findings stand out. A rubric written for the task is the strongest lever for agreement between an LLM judge and human graders, but the reported figures answer different questions and rarely come with the human agreement they must be read against. The central validation gap lies where examination law is most demanding: defensible alternative solutions, follow-on errors, and the examiner's correction of model judgments. And rubric-centred grading is the most auditable family, because it makes the standard, its application and the final decision checkable. From this we derive the trustworthy rubric judge: an instance rubric that credits arguments and alternative paths,evidence checked in code, probes, repeated runs, calibration against independent human grades,logging, and an examiner who reads every script. We state what each safeguard rests on, what remains to be tested, and the uses the evidence supports today.
title: SoK: Grading Open-Text Legal Answers, from Law School Exams to Trustworthy Rubric Judges
title_translated: 综述：从法学院考试到可信评分裁判的开放式法律答案评分
summary_translated: 法学院学生通过开放式作答接受考核：案例解答、论文和备忘录，需将法律应用于一组事实。这类答案评分成本高昂，人工评分者意见分歧严重，而大型语言模型（LLMs）现在能够大规模地进行评分，既可用于教学，也可用于测试法律 AI 的基准。本文系统化地梳理了如何评估开放式法律答案。我们从教育测量学和考试法规中推导出八个理想标准，包括有效性、可靠性、理由充分性、对合理替代解决方案的认可、对作弊的鲁棒性以及人工监督。随后，我们对照这些标准比较了八种评估范式，从非结构化人工评分到具有实例特定评分标准的 LLM 评分员及成对比较。三个发现尤为突出：为任务定制的评分标准是提升 LLM 评分员与人工评分者一致性最强的杠杆，但报告的数据回答的问题不同，且很少附带人类一致性作为参照。核心验证缺口出现在考试法规要求最严格的领域：合理替代解决方案、后续错误以及考官对模型判断的修正。而以评分标准为中心的评分是最具可审计性的类别，因为它使标准、应用过程和最终决策均可核查。由此我们提出可信评分裁判：一种实例化评分标准，认可论点与替代路径，证据在代码中可查，通过探测、重复运行、与独立人工评分校准、日志记录以及阅卷人逐份审阅。我们阐明了每一项保障措施的基础，指出了尚待验证之处，以及当前证据所能支持的应用。

summary: The number of attention heads in a transformer is usually set by convention or grid search. We test a simple heuristic for setting it in advance: estimate the intrinsic dimension of token representations without labels, and use roughly that many heads. We estimate intrinsic dimension with a nested-dropout VAE trained on DistilBERT embeddings of WikiText-2, choosing the KL weight at the knee of the VAE's rate-distortion curve rather than by hand. This gives $k^*=9.2$ (95% CI [8.6, 9.8]). In a small 4-layer transformer trained from scratch, 10 heads and 32 heads are statistically equivalent on SST-2 and on MRPC (paired TOST over 10 seeds, $\pm1$ point margin), with 69% fewer attention parameters for the 10-head model. Training 10 heads from the start also slightly outperforms training 32 heads and pruning to 10 (0.6 points, $p=0.008$). The evidence is narrow: two classification tasks, one small architecture, no pretrained models, and no formal link between intrinsic dimension and head count. We present the result as a practical heuristic worth testing at larger scale, not as a general principle.
title: Choosing the Number of Attention Heads from Intrinsic Dimension: A Small-Scale Study
comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Code: this https URL
title_translated: 从内在维度选择注意力头数：一项小规模研究
summary_translated: Transformer中的注意力头数量通常由惯例或网格搜索决定。我们测试了一种简单的启发式方法：预先估计无标签的标记表示的内在维度，并使用大致相同数量的头。我们通过在WikiText-2的DistilBERT嵌入上训练嵌套丢弃的VAE来估计内在维度，选择VAE速率-失真曲线拐点处的KL权重，而非手动设定。结果得到k*=9.2（95%置信区间[8.6, 9.8]）。在一个从零开始训练的小型4层Transformer中，10个头和32个头在SST-2和MRPC任务上统计等效（基于10次种子的配对TOST检验，±1分误差范围），且10头模型的注意力参数减少了69%。从一开始就训练10个头也略微优于先训练32个头再剪枝至10个（提升0.6分，p=0.008）。然而证据较为有限：仅两个分类任务、一种小型架构、无预训练模型，且未建立内在维度与头数之间的正式关联。我们将其作为值得在更大规模上验证的实用启发式方法提出，而非普遍原则。

summary: Agent skills adapt frozen models through editable external instructions. Revising several rules at once makes changes difficult to inspect, while judging each local edit only by its immediate score can discard useful intermediate states. We introduce AtomSearch, which keeps revision actions local while using subsequent skill states to guide search. Contrastive atomic editing links each primitive rule edit to failed and successful executions, a behavioral hypothesis, and an intended scope. Skill-State Tree Search (STS) evaluates short edit compositions and selectively retains them as executable states that can be revisited and extended. Outcome memory supplies later proposals with observed repair and regression statistics. We evaluate AtomSearch across four tasks and five target models. With deepseek-v4-flash, it exceeds SkillOpt on three of four tasks, including a 9.68-percentage-point gain on LiveMathematicianBench, and SkillOpt's final skills contain 2.3-19.7 times as many characters. In 67% of completed searches, the best validation state passes through an ancestor that was not highest-scoring at its depth. These results show how local rule edits can support the exploration of useful revision paths and yield compact skills, with additional offline evaluations used to explore alternative states.
title: AtomSearch: Evidence-Grounded Tree Search for Agent Skill Optimization
title_translated: AtomSearch：基于证据的树搜索以优化智能体技能
summary_translated: 智能体技能通过可编辑的外部指令适应冻结模型。同时修改多个规则会使变更难以检查，而仅根据即时得分判断每次局部修改可能忽略有用的中间状态。我们提出AtomSearch，保持修改动作局部性的同时，利用后续技能状态引导搜索。对比原子编辑将每个基本规则修改与失败和成功执行、行为假设及预期范围相联系。技能状态树搜索（STS）评估短序列编辑组合，并选择性保留为可回溯和扩展的可执行状态。结果记忆为后续提议提供观察到的修复与退化统计数据。我们在四个任务和五个目标模型上评估AtomSearch。以deepseek-v4-flash为例，其在四项任务中有三项超越SkillOpt，包括在LiveMathematicianBench上取得9.68个百分点的提升，且SkillOpt最终技能的字符数是其2.3至19.7倍。在67%的完成搜索中，最佳验证状态经过了一个在其深度时并非最高分的祖先状态。这些结果表明，局部规则修改可支持探索有用修订路径并生成紧凑技能，额外的离线评估用于探索替代状态。

summary: Within the most recent two decades, machine translation (MT) has been advanced from a research area to a mature, deployed technology for prose text and most language pairs. However, language has different dimensions of meaning, and the alluded progress has primarily been demonstrated for propositional meaning.   In this small exploratory study, we investigate whether one type of affective meaning, namely different types of linguistically expressed media bias, are retained under automatic translation for two language pairs, English and German as the source languages, and Bulgarian as the target language. We evaluate four state-of-the-art translation methods to answer the question whether and to what degree a loss of non-neutral language (specifically, 27 types of media bias) can occur as a result of applying MT.   Our empirical findings are consistent with the claim that MT does not fully retain existing news bias of its input source text, but also may add extra bias of its own. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first experimental study of MT media bias retention.
title: Does Machine Translation Retain Media Bias?
title_translated: 机器翻译是否保留媒体偏见？
summary_translated: 在过去二十年中，机器翻译（MT）已从研究领域发展为成熟且广泛部署的文本翻译技术，适用于大多数语言对。然而，语言具有多种意义维度，现有进展主要体现在命题意义方面。在本项小规模探索性研究中，我们考察一种情感意义类型——即不同类型的语言表达媒体偏见——在英德语作为源语言、保加利亚语为目标语言的两种语言对中，自动翻译是否得以保留。我们评估了四种最先进的翻译方法，以回答应用MT是否会以及在何种程度上导致非中立语言（特别是27种媒体偏见）的损失。我们的实证发现支持MT未能完全保留输入源文本中的新闻偏见，甚至可能引入自身的新偏见。据我们所知，这是首个关于MT媒体偏见保留问题的实验研究。

summary: Weight pruning can degrade the accuracy of large reasoning models (LRMs), yet it remains unclear whether it damages reasoning itself. We find that much of this degradation stems from a failure to stop rather than to reason. As sparsity increases, pruned LRMs increasingly fail to terminate within the token budget, often after the correct answer has appeared in their reasoning, instead falling into repetitive loops, even though they still recognize where the dense model would stop. We further find that the hidden-state difference between terminating and looping continuations is consistent across pruned checkpoints, suggesting a shared direction associated with committing to an answer. Building on this, we propose Termination-Guided Activation Steering (TGAS), a training-free method that adds this direction to the residual stream at inference time. Across six LRMs, three pruning pipelines, and math and code benchmarks, TGAS improves termination and overall accuracy while reducing repetitive reasoning and generation length, showing that this failure is actionable.
title: To Reason but Not to Stop: Understanding and Recovering Pruned Large Reasoning Models
title_translated: 推理但不终止：理解并恢复被剪枝的大规模推理模型
summary_translated: 权重剪枝会降低大规模推理模型（LRMs）的准确性，但尚不清楚这是否损害了推理本身。我们发现，大部分性能下降源于无法终止，而非无法推理。随着稀疏度增加，剪枝后的LRM越来越无法在令牌预算内终止，即使正确答案已在推理过程中出现，仍会陷入重复循环，尽管它们仍能识别出密集模型会在何处停止。我们进一步发现，终止与循环延续之间的隐藏状态差异在不同剪枝检查点间保持一致，表明存在一个与确定答案相关的共同方向。基于此，我们提出终止引导激活引导（TGAS），一种无需训练的方法，在推理时向残差流添加该方向。在六个LRM、三种剪枝管道以及数学和代码基准上的实验表明，TGAS提升了终止能力与整体准确率，同时减少重复推理和生成长度，证明这种失败是可纠正的。

summary: Reasoning over infinitely long documents is becoming a reality with recurrent memory agents. However, increasing context length exacerbates the trade-off between reasoning performance and inference efficiency. Inspired by Kahneman's account of fast and slow thinking, we propose MemDuet, a dual-process memory framework that learns to coordinate a small language model for fast, parallel evidence selection from raw context chunks (System 1) with a large language model for memory-update verification and memory updates in document order (System 2). We train MemDuet in three stages: supervised fine-tuning of System 1 for evidence selection, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) of System 2 for verification and memory rewriting, and joint optimization of both policies to coordinate selection and updating for long-context reasoning. Experiments on diverse long-context reasoning benchmarks (RULER-HQA, LongBench v2, and 2WikiMultiHopQA) demonstrate a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off as context length grows. Averaged across evaluation settings on the three datasets, MemDuet achieves an end-to-end inference speedup of 9.74x and an output-token reduction of 73.91% relative to RL-MemAgent.
title: MemDuet: Learning Dual-Process Memory for Long-Context Reasoning
title_translated: MemDuet：面向长上下文推理的学习双过程记忆框架
summary_translated: 随着循环记忆智能体的发展，对无限长文档进行推理正成为现实。然而，增加上下文长度加剧了推理性能与推理效率之间的权衡。受卡尼曼关于快思考与慢思考理论的启发，我们提出MemDuet，一种双过程记忆框架，学习协调一个小语言模型以快速并行地从原始上下文块中选择证据（系统1），与一个大语言模型按文档顺序进行记忆更新验证和记忆更新（系统2）。MemDuet分三个阶段训练：系统1在证据选择上的监督微调，系统2通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行验证与记忆重写，以及两者策略的联合优化以协调选择与更新，实现长上下文推理。在多样化的长上下文推理基准测试（RULER-HQA、LongBench v2 和 2WikiMultiHopQA）上的实验表明，随着上下文长度增长，MemDuet展现出有利的准确率-效率权衡。在三个数据集的平均评估设置下，MemDuet相比RL-MemAgent实现了9.74倍的端到端推理加速和73.91%的输出令牌减少。

summary: Rubric-based evaluation assesses the responses of large language models (LLMs) by aggregating the verification results of explicit criteria, yet not all criteria matter equally. However, existing methods commonly aggregate the verification results with uniform weighting, which assigns minor and overlapping criteria the same weight as essential ones and thus produces misleading evaluation scores. Although some methods prompt an LLM to directly assign weights, direct weighting requires a holistic judgment over all criteria that LLMs struggle to make reliably. To address these limitations, we propose Importance-Aware Criteria Weighting (ICW), which derives the weights of criteria from pairwise importance comparisons made by an LLM. Specifically, ICW transforms the holistic judgment over all criteria into a series of pairwise importance comparisons, checks and revises inconsistent comparisons, and derives the weights from the principal eigenvector of the comparison matrix. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ICW consistently outperforms uniform weighting and competitive weighting methods, and translates into better policy models in downstream reinforcement learning.
title: Not All Criteria Matter: Importance-Aware Criteria Weighting for Rubric-Based LLM Evaluation
title_translated: 并非所有标准都重要：基于评分标准的LLM评估中的重要性感知权重分配
summary_translated: 基于评分标准的评估通过汇总显式标准的验证结果来评估大语言模型（LLMs）的响应，但并非所有标准的重要性均等。然而，现有方法通常采用均匀加权聚合验证结果，导致次要且重叠的标准与关键标准获得相同权重，从而产生误导性的评估分数。尽管某些方法提示LLM直接分配权重，但直接加权需要对所有标准进行整体判断，而LLMs难以可靠地完成这一任务。为解决这些局限性，我们提出重要性感知标准权重分配（ICW），该方法通过LLM进行成对重要性比较来推导标准权重。具体而言，ICW将对所有标准的整体判断转化为一系列成对重要性比较，检查并修正不一致的比较，并从比较矩阵的主特征向量中推导出权重。大量实验表明，ICW在性能上持续优于均匀加权和竞争性加权方法，并在下游强化学习中生成更优的策略模型。

summary: LLMs have achieved strong performance on chemical prediction benchmarks. However, existing evaluation methods typically provide target entity identity information directly, making it difficult to determine whether model predictions arise from transferable structure-property reasoning capabilities or rely on target-related contextual information or memory retrieval. We propose the Identity-Blinded Reasoning Diagnostic framework to evaluate chemical prediction models when target entity identity information is hidden. In this framework, the target is no longer directly defined by its entity identity, but instead by a known source entity and an explicit structural edit operation. This setting preserves the information required to determine the target while reducing the opportunity for models to access target identity cues. We evaluate this framework across six tasks spanning odor prediction, molecular property prediction, retrosynthesis, and reaction yield prediction. The results show that models generally achieve better prediction performance when source and target entity properties are consistent. Providing explicit source entity labels further strengthens this dependence. Moreover, while keeping the target entity, structural change, and ground-truth label unchanged, replacing only the source entity label causes some model predictions to systematically shift toward the substituted source labels. These results indicate that high benchmark accuracy in chemical prediction tasks does not necessarily imply that LLMs possess reliable structure-property reasoning capabilities. Our diagnostic framework provides a controlled evaluation approach for testing whether models can genuinely update predictions according to entity changes. The framework can be extended to other AI for Science tasks, particularly those where targets can be defined through transformations of known entities.
title: Beyond Benchmark Accuracy: A Diagnostic Test for LLM Chemical Prediction
title_translated: 超越基准准确率：用于LLM化学预测的诊断测试
summary_translated: 大语言模型在化学预测基准上已取得优异表现。然而，现有评估方法通常直接提供目标实体的身份信息，使得难以判断模型预测是源于可迁移的结构-性质推理能力，还是依赖于目标相关的上下文信息或记忆检索。为此，我们提出了身份盲化推理诊断框架，用于在隐藏目标实体身份信息的情况下评估化学预测模型。在此框架中，目标不再由其实体身份直接定义，而是由一个已知源实体和明确的结构编辑操作定义。该设置保留了确定目标所需的信息，同时减少了模型获取目标身份线索的机会。我们在六个任务上评估该框架，涵盖气味预测、分子性质预测、逆合成和反应产率预测。结果表明，当源与目标实体属性一致时，模型通常表现出更好的预测性能；提供明确的源实体标签进一步增强了这种依赖性。此外，在保持目标实体、结构变化和真实标签不变的前提下，仅替换源实体标签会导致部分模型预测系统性地偏向替代的源标签。这些结果表明，化学预测任务中的高基准准确率并不一定意味着LLMs具备可靠的结构-性质推理能力。我们的诊断框架提供了一种受控的评估方法，用于检验模型是否能根据实体变化真实更新预测。该框架可扩展至其他科学领域的人工智能任务，特别是那些可通过已知实体的变换定义目标的任务。

summary: Majority Voting (MV) is a simple and widely used strategy which improves the reasoning accuracy of Large Language Models (LLMs) by allocating additional inference-time computation. Specifically, in MV multiple Chain-of-Thoughts (CoTs) are independently sampled and the most frequent final answer is selected. In this work, we propose Length-Conditioned Majority Voting (LCMV), a Test-Time Training approach which improves MV leveraging an empirical observation that has recently been established in several studies: longer CoTs tend to be associated with a lower probability of correctness. We formulate this inductive bias as a length-conditioned prior probability, which is modeled by a simple logistic function. Moreover, we adapt this prior at test time using only unlabeled testing data and without fine-tuning the LLM. Finally, the adapted prior is used to weight the vote of each sampled answer. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs and reasoning benchmarks show that LCMV consistently improves over both standard MV and existing length-based and confidence-based aggregation strategies, while retaining the simplicity and model-agnostic nature of MV. Our code is available at: https://github.com/aimagelab/LCMV.
title: Frustratingly Easy Majority Voting Using Length Conditioning
title_translated: 利用长度调节实现令人沮丧的简单多数投票
summary_translated: 多数投票（MV）是一种简单且广泛应用的策略，通过增加推理时间计算量来提升大语言模型（LLMs）的推理准确性。具体而言，在MV中，独立采样多个思维链（CoTs），并选择出现频率最高的最终答案。本文提出长度调节多数投票（LCMV），一种测试时训练方法，通过利用近期多项研究中确立的经验观察——较长的思维链往往与较低的正确概率相关——来改进MV。我们将这一归纳偏置建模为长度调节的先验概率，使用简单的逻辑函数表示。此外，我们仅使用无标签测试数据在测试时自适应调整该先验，无需微调LLM。最后，将调整后的先验用于加权每个采样答案的投票。在多个LLM和推理基准上的大量实验表明，LCMV在性能上持续优于标准MV以及现有的基于长度和置信度的聚合策略，同时保持了MV的简洁性和模型无关性。代码已公开：https://github.com/aimagelab/LCMV。

summary: A reasoning prompt can improve one deployment and degrade another. RCCM (Reasoning-Control Capability Mismatch) examines these reversals by pairing answers to the same questions with records of how generation ends. Across five open-weight deployments and nine strategies, aggregate accuracy hides substantial question-level gains and harms; a common-budget MATH500 evaluation examines transfer on a separate sample. On 60 additional questions, concise reasoning improves Phi's automatic answer matching at a 2,048-token cap across three collections, but sharply reduces Qwen's. Author-reviewed final-answer commitments give a smaller, statistically unresolved Phi gain. Reserving an answer stage also improves matching, with additional input and call costs. These results show why a prompt benefit must be interpreted alongside its execution and evaluation: matching a reference answer need not mean delivering it, and an apparent compression benefit may admit another explanation. RCCM records this evidence for reproducible transfer comparisons.
title: RCCM: Diagnosing Gains and Harms in Reasoning-Prompt Transfer
comment: 21 pages, 2 figures. Includes a size-limited reproducibility subset as ancillary files
title_translated: 推理提示迁移中的增益与损害诊断
summary_translated: 一个推理提示可能在一个部署中提升性能，而在另一个部署中反而降低性能。RCCM（推理控制能力不匹配）通过将同一问题的答案与其生成结束记录配对，来分析这些反转现象。在五个开源权重部署和九种策略中，总体准确率掩盖了显著的问题级增益与损害；采用固定预算的MATH500评估在独立样本上考察迁移效果。在额外60个问题上，简洁推理在三个数据集上使Phi在2,048 token限制下自动答案匹配能力得到提升，但显著降低了Qwen的表现。经过作者评审的最终答案承诺显示，Phi的增益较小且统计上未显著。保留答案阶段也提升了匹配度，但带来额外输入和调用成本。这些结果说明，必须结合执行和评估环境来解释提示带来的收益：匹配参考答案并不等于实际交付该答案，而看似压缩带来的优势可能另有解释。RCCM记录了这些证据，以支持可复现的迁移比较。

summary: Sampling multiple chain-of-thought rationales from a language model can uncover correct solutions missed by a single attempt. However, these rationales are typically lengthy, making repeated autoregressive generation costly. Continuous latent reasoning offers a compact alternative, but point-valued methods condition repeated answer sampling on a single rationale, which can limit exploration of diverse paths and answer coverage. We thus propose rationale distribution distillation (RDD), training a conditional flow over fixed-length latent sequences by distilling from multiple textual reasoning paths. Furthermore, we expand the distillation targets through within-query mixup, interpolating between complete latent rationales for the same query. The flow nonautoregressively generates the entire latent sequence, and a frozen language model autoregressively decodes answers from sampled rationale contexts. Empirically, the resulting distributional reasoner achieves higher answer coverage than the evaluated point-valued latent reasoning baselines, particularly on advanced mathematical tasks.
title: Rationale Distribution Distillation via Flow Matching for Distributional Continuous Latent Reasoning
title_translated: 通过流匹配实现分布连续潜在推理的论证分布蒸馏
summary_translated: 从语言模型中采样多个思维链论证可以发现单次尝试遗漏的正确解法。然而，这些论证通常冗长，重复的自回归生成代价高昂。连续潜在推理提供了一种紧凑替代方案，但点值方法将多次答案采样条件化于单一论证，可能限制对多样化路径和答案覆盖的探索。因此，我们提出论证分布蒸馏（RDD），通过从多个文本推理路径中蒸馏，训练一个固定长度潜在序列的条件流。此外，我们通过查询内混合扩展蒸馏目标，对同一查询的完整潜在论证进行插值。该流非自回归地生成整个潜在序列，随后冻结的语言模型自回归地从采样的论证上下文中解码答案。实证结果表明，所提出的分布推理器在答案覆盖率上优于评估的点值潜在推理基线，尤其在高级数学任务上表现更优。

summary: We present OpenTWBench, an open evaluation suite for Taiwan-domain knowledge in large language models, built around two benchmarks. tw-exam-bench contains 255,854 four-option questions across 148 academic subjects, from fifteen years of Taiwan's national examinations published as open data by the Ministry of Examination; answer keys agree across 31,312 duplicated question groups at 99.91%, with all 27 disagreements accounted for. A reviewed second pass withdrew 2,180 items whose stems depend on a figure the text does not carry; all scores use the remaining 253,674. tw-formosa-bench contains 1,696 difficulty-curated questions about everyday and contemporary Taiwan - the Taiwan that licensing examinations never ask about - generated from a community-curated corpus under a discipline in which no model writes a ground truth, and curated against a frozen seven-model pool so that the pool scored at the passing margin (46.9-74.6%, median ~54%); a leave-one-out experiment shows the selection preserves model ranking (near-zero bias). Within six weeks the frontier had cleared that band: of 108 models now on the public board, 22 score above its ceiling, the best 91.6%.   We also document how much of a score comes from the apparatus rather than the model. On identical questions, switching answer extraction from pattern matching to an explicit \boxed{} answer moves accuracy from 20.8% to 93.9%; a single placeholder character in a system prompt moved one model from last (58.2%) to first (83.9%) on the same benchmark; doubling the thinking budget from 8k to 16k tokens bought 0.2% while shuffling which questions failed; and a three-judge validation panel proved to be one judge in disguise, two members approving 92-99% of everything shown. We release all datasets, per-item difficulty data, curation manifests and a leaderboard at https://opentwbench.ai
title: OpenTWBench (Open Taiwan Benchmark): Taiwan-Domain Knowledge Evaluation for Large Language Models, and How the Measurement Apparatus Shapes the Score
comment: 19 pages, no figures. Datasets, per-item difficulty data and a public leaderboard at this https URL
title_translated: OpenTWBench（开放台湾基准）：大语言模型在台湾领域知识的评估，以及测量工具如何影响得分
summary_translated: 我们提出了OpenTWBench，一个针对大语言模型在台湾领域知识的开放评估套件，基于两个基准。tw-exam-bench包含148个学术主题中255,854道四选一题目，数据源自台湾教育部发布的十五年国家考试公开数据；答案一致性在31,312组重复题目中达到99.91%，所有27处差异均已记录。经过第二轮审阅，剔除了2,180个依赖文本未携带图表的题目，最终使用剩余的253,674道题。tw-formosa-bench包含1,696道精心设计的关于日常与当代台湾的问题——这些是执照考试从未涉及的内容——由社区共建语料库生成，并在无模型可提供真实答案的学科背景下，通过冻结的七模型池进行筛选，使该池得分处于及格线附近（46.9%-74.6%，中位数约54%）；留一法实验表明该选择保留了模型排名（偏差接近零）。六周内前沿模型已突破该区间：目前公开榜单上的108个模型中有22个得分超过其上限，最高达91.6%。我们还记录了评分结果中有多大比例来自评估工具本身而非模型表现。在相同题目上，将答案提取方式从模式匹配改为显式\boxed{}格式，准确率从20.8%提升至93.9%；系统提示中单个占位符字符的改变使某模型得分从末位（58.2%）跃升至首位（83.9%）；思考预算从8k增至16k token仅带来0.2%提升，且失败题目顺序随机变化；三名评审小组实则等同于一名评审，两名成员对展示内容批准率达92%-99%。我们已在https://opentwbench.ai发布所有数据集、每项难度数据、筛选清单和排行榜。

summary: Enterprise group chats record project progress, decisions, task ownership, and other organizational information valuable to enterprise agents. Reliable retrieval is challenging because evidence spans interleaved threads, channels, and time, with meaning and authority conditioned on the speaker. Neither RAG's independent chunk retrieval nor memory systems' summary-based consolidation can reliably recover such distributed evidence. We present EGCForest, a novel multi-view hierarchical memory framework for enterprise group chats. EGCForest organizes an immutable message log into three complementary forests: a Channel forest for temporal workflows, an Actor forest for speaker-conditioned context, and an Artifact forest for deliverable lifecycles. Cross-view connections are enabled by a Placement Map and sparse structural bridges. Built on this memory backbone, EGCForest retrieves and assembles evidence by jointly leveraging message-level relevance, hierarchical context from forest summaries, and cross-view links, recovering distributed evidence. Experiments on three enterprise-chat benchmarks show that EGCForest consistently outperforms RAG and memory-system baselines, improving answer accuracy by up to 20.85 points over MemOS while supporting efficient online retrieval.
title: EGCForest: Structured Agent Memory Organization for Enterprise Group Chats
title_translated: EGCForest：面向企业群聊的结构化智能体记忆组织
summary_translated: 企业群聊记录项目进展、决策、任务归属及其他对企业智能体有价值的信息。可靠检索面临挑战，因为证据分散在交错的线程、频道和时间中，其意义和权威性取决于发言者。无论是RAG的独立分块检索，还是记忆系统的摘要式整合，均难以可靠恢复此类分布式证据。我们提出EGCForest，一种用于企业群聊的新型多视角层次化记忆框架。EGCForest将不可变的消息日志组织为三个互补的森林：通道森林用于时间工作流，角色森林用于说话人条件上下文，成果森林用于交付物生命周期。跨视角连接通过放置图和稀疏结构桥接实现。基于此记忆骨干，EGCForest通过联合利用消息级相关性、森林摘要提供的层次上下文以及跨视角链接，实现证据的检索与组装，成功恢复分布式证据。在三个企业聊天基准上的实验表明，EGCForest持续优于RAG和记忆系统基线，在MemOS基础上最多提升20.85个百分点，同时支持高效的在线检索。

summary: Human values shape how we expect language models to behave. Dominant alignment approaches treat values as global objectives, although the appropriate value orientation is personal and contextual. Training-free alignment can steer models toward target values at inference time, yet has been largely evaluated in single-turn settings and with a single steering direction (e.g., toward safety). We evaluate four prompt- and activation-based steering methods in multi-turn conversations, where user and assistant models push toward the same or opposing, equally desirable values. We track alignment with a linear probe across three models and two value trade-offs. When assistant and user pull in opposite directions, the side matching the assistant's baseline bias often prevails, and effects that look successful early often fade or reverse after a few turns. Steering should therefore be evaluated over full conversations and in both directions of a value trade-off.
title: Model vs. User: Whose Values Prevail? Inference-Time Value Alignment in Multi-Turn Conversations
title_translated: 模型 vs. 用户：谁的价值占主导？多轮对话中的推理时价值对齐
summary_translated: 人类价值观塑造我们对语言模型行为的期待。主流对齐方法将价值观视为全局目标，但合适的值导向应是个人化且情境化的。无需训练的对齐方法可在推理时引导模型向目标价值观靠拢，但此前大多在单轮设置下评估，且仅测试单一引导方向（如安全性）。我们在多轮对话中评估四种基于提示和激活的引导方法，其中用户与助手模型可能朝相同或相反但同样可取的价值方向推进。我们通过线性探测跟踪三种模型和两种价值权衡下的对齐情况。当用户与助手朝相反方向拉扯时，往往与助手基线偏见一致的一方占优，且早期看似成功的效应在几轮后常会消退甚至反转。因此，对齐应基于完整对话过程，并在价值权衡的双向中进行评估。

summary: An agent that drives an LLM sends the model the same conversation again and again, and each turn adds only a little text at the end. Inference engines reuse the KV cache of the shared prefix, so only the new tokens pass through the model. However, tokenization has no such shortcut. The CPU front end of the serving engine converts every request back into token IDs from its first character, which lengthens the time to first token (TTFT) and consumes CPU on every turn.   We present Delta Tokenizer, a CPU tokenization front end that tokenizes only the delta between a request and the previous request of the same session. It retains the earlier token sequence, encodes again only the appended text and the short tail whose tokens the append could affect, and joins the two only at a position the tokenizer's splitting rules themselves cannot move, which keeps the result exact. For long requests with no state to reuse, it cuts the text where practical tokenizers already keep neighboring pieces independent, encodes the pieces on several cores at once, and concatenates the outputs into the reference encoding, exactly. A shared CPU pool schedules these chunks together with the short incremental updates, so an update runs between two chunks rather than behind an entire long job.   The incremental path shortens the tokenization of a session turn by roughly 40x relative to the Hugging Face reference tokenizer, and on 16 cores the chunk-parallel path encodes a four-million-character request 8.2x faster than a serial encode and 1.6-2.1x faster than LoPT. Inside SGLang, Delta Tokenizer reduces the median TTFT through the chat interface by 59% at 100K tokens and brings the P99 TTFT of agent sessions down 9.5x under load and 23x when long requests tie up the front end. Every output we checked matches the reference, among them 41.8 billion documents encoded by its fast encoder.
title: Delta Tokenizer: Reference-Identical Tokenization of Session Deltas and Segment-Parallelism for Long Prompts on Multicore CPUs
comment: 42 pages (16-page main text, references, and supplementary material), 14 figures, 35 tables. The incremental tokenization path and the fast encoder are open source in toktier at this https URL . The chunk-parallel path, the CPU pool scheduler, and the SGLang adapter will be released in the same repository
title_translated: Delta Tokenizer：会话增量的参考一致分词与长提示在多核CPU上的段并行
summary_translated: 驱动大模型的智能体反复发送相同的对话，每轮仅在末尾添加少量文本。推理引擎可复用共享前缀的KV缓存，因此只有新token进入模型。然而分词并无此类捷径。服务引擎的CPU前端需从每个请求的第一个字符重新转换为token ID，这延长了首个token响应时间（TTFT），并在每轮消耗CPU资源。我们提出Delta Tokenizer，一种CPU分词前端，仅对同一会话中当前请求与前一次请求之间的增量部分进行分词。它保留先前的token序列，仅重新编码追加文本及其可能受影响的短尾部分，并在分词规则自身无法移动的位置拼接，确保结果完全精确。对于无状态可复用的长请求，它在实际分词器已保持相邻片段独立的位置进行切分，利用多个核心并行编码各片段，再将输出合并为参考编码，完全精确。共享CPU池将这些分块与短增量更新一起调度，使更新运行于两块之间而非整个长任务之后。增量路径使会话轮次的分词速度相比Hugging Face参考分词器缩短约40倍；在16核上，分块并行路径编码四百万字符请求的速度比串行编码快8.2倍，比LoPT快1.6-2.1倍。在SGLang中，Delta Tokenizer使聊天界面的中位TTFT降低59%（10万token），在负载下将代理会话的P99 TTFT降低9.5倍，长请求占用前端时降低23倍。我们检查的所有输出均与参考一致，其中包括其快速编码器处理的418亿份文档。

summary: Recent work lets LLM agents evolve their own harness, up to the team itself. Yet in human groups, the same abilities achieve different outcomes under different social conditions. Borrowing the notion of scaffolding from developmental psychology, we investigate whether the social scaffolding of a self-evolving multi-agent system (MAS), namely its team composition and structure of interdependence (e.g., collaboration, conformity, or competition), shapes how the team evolves. We present AGORA (Agents Growing through Organization and Relational Arrangements), a framework that varies the two axes independently across three evolution mechanisms. Across web search, codebase understanding, and document QA, we find that (1) evolution alone rarely helps, while the right scaffolding surpasses a strong agent evolved alone by up to 25 points; (2) it does so by moving authority to the most capable member while the others step back; and (3) this member, having grown within the team, outperforms the same model alone. Designing a self-evolving MAS thus requires designing its social scaffolding, which shapes not only how its agents learn, but who gets to lead.
title: Evolve Together, Fall into Place: How Social Scaffolding Shapes Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems
title_translated: 共同演进，自然归位：社会支架如何塑造自演化多智能体系统
summary_translated: 近期研究允许LLM智能体自主演化其协作机制，直至团队本身。然而在人类群体中，相同能力在不同社会条件下会产生不同结果。借鉴发展心理学中的“支架”概念，我们探究自演化多智能体系统（MAS）的社会支架——即团队构成与相互依赖结构（如合作、从众或竞争）——是否影响团队演化过程。我们提出AGORA（通过组织与关系安排成长的智能体），一个可独立调节两个维度的框架，涵盖三种演化机制。在网页搜索、代码库理解与文档问答任务中，我们发现：（1）仅靠演化很少有效，而恰当的支架可使团队性能超越单独演化的强智能体高达25分；（2）其机制是将权威转移给最能干的成员，其余成员主动退让；（3）该成员因在团队中成长，其表现优于单独运行的同一模型。因此，设计自演化MAS需要精心设计其社会支架，因为它不仅影响智能体如何学习，更决定谁将担任领导角色。

summary: Speculative decoding's effectiveness is governed by two quantities: the acceptance rate of drafted tokens and the cost of producing them. We show the two objectives can be co-optimized with algorithm-system co-design, and present JetSpec++, which retains a strong learned draft model while hiding its cost almost entirely. JetSpec++ combines three components: intra-block self refinement, which trains the draft model to iteratively correct its own parallel predictions within a block of tokens; inter-block foresight drafting, which begins the next block before the current one is verified; and pipelined drafting and verification, which overlaps the two stages so drafting's marginal wall-clock cost approaches zero. In comparison with state-of-the-art speculative decoding methods, JetSpec++ attains a wall-clock speedup of up to $7.45\times$ over autoregressive (AR) decoding and $1.54\times$ over DSpark, with up to 1,361 tokens per second for a single request on GB200, and an average acceptance length of 8.94 across seven benchmarks, while preserving the target model's output distribution. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/hao-ai-lab/JetSpec.
title: JetSpec++: Foresight Parallel Drafting with Self Refinements
comment: 31 pages, 4 figures, 16 tables. Zhaoxiang Feng and Lanxiang Hu contributed equally. Code and models: this https URL
title_translated: JetSpec++：通过自我精炼实现前瞻并行草稿生成
summary_translated: 推测解码的有效性由两个因素决定：草稿标记的接受率和生成成本。我们展示了通过算法-系统协同设计可以同时优化这两个目标，并提出了JetSpec++，该方法在保留强大学习到的草稿模型的同时，几乎完全隐藏了其生成成本。JetSpec++结合了三个组件：块内自我精炼，训练草稿模型在标记块内迭代修正自身的并行预测；块间前瞻草稿生成，在当前块验证前就开始下一区块的生成；以及流水线式草稿与验证重叠，使草稿生成的边际时钟时间成本趋近于零。与最先进的推测解码方法相比，JetSpec++在GB200上实现了高达7.45倍于自回归（AR）解码和1.54倍于DSpark的时钟速度提升，单个请求每秒可处理高达1,361个标记，七个基准测试平均接受长度为8.94，同时保持目标模型的输出分布不变。我们的代码和模型可在https://github.com/hao-ai-lab/JetSpec获取。

summary: Self-distillation in agentic reinforcement learning has produced a growing number of methods. However, existing evaluations often reuse published baseline scores under differing experimental conditions, provide few direct comparisons among contemporaneous methods, and give limited attention to training stability and computational cost. These limitations obscure the source of reported gains and the practical strengths and weaknesses of competing methods. Costly agent training further motivates a common basis for comparison. To address these gaps, we compare ten representative methods against GRPO on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, Search-QA, and WebShop across three model sizes. Our study comprises 132 training runs totaling 12,124.4 recorded H800 GPU-hours, with repeated evaluations over eight rollout seeds for the pretrained backbones and all eleven trained methods. Beyond final task performance, we examine training progress, stability, and measured computational cost. Our evaluation yields three key findings. First, gains over GRPO remain limited in scope, with no method consistently outperforming it across settings. Second, strong final performance can mask unstable training. Third, additional training cost does not consistently translate into better performance. We establish this benchmark to support fair, comprehensive comparison and guide future research toward reliable and cost-effective improvements in agent training. Project page: https://aim-uofa.github.io/Self-Distillation-AgentRL/
title: More Methods, Better Agents? A Reality Check on Self-Distillation in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
title_translated: 更多方法，更好智能体？关于代理强化学习中自蒸馏的现实检验
summary_translated: 在代理强化学习中，自蒸馏已催生大量新方法。然而，现有评估往往在不同实验条件下重复使用已发表的基线分数，对同期方法缺乏直接比较，并且对训练稳定性与计算成本关注不足。这些局限性模糊了报告性能提升的来源，也难以判断各方法的实际优劣。高昂的代理训练成本更凸显了建立统一比较基准的必要性。为此，我们在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、Search-QA和WebShop四个任务上，针对三种模型规模，对比了十种代表性方法与GRPO的表现。研究共包含132次训练运行，总计记录12,124.4个H800 GPU小时，并对预训练骨干网络及全部十一种训练方法进行了八次回滚种子的重复评估。除了最终任务表现外，我们还考察了训练过程、稳定性及实际计算成本。评估得出三项关键发现：第一，在多数场景下，各方法相对于GRPO的提升仍有限，无一方法在所有设置中持续领先；第二，优异的最终表现可能掩盖不稳定的训练过程；第三，更高的训练成本并不必然带来更好的性能。我们建立此基准以支持公平、全面的比较，引导未来研究朝向可靠且低成本的智能体训练改进方向。项目页面：https://aim-uofa.github.io/Self-Distillation-AgentRL/

summary: AI-text detection generally asks whether a machine wrote a text. As AI becomes an increasingly integral and accepted part of writing, the more relevant question is no longer whether AI was used, but how much of the text reflects human contribution. A prominent line of work estimates this by measuring how predictive a person's prompt is of the final text. We show that this measure can be easily manipulated. We introduce SPECIFICITY PADDING that simply asks the model to copy a few random IDs from the prompt, and that alone makes a title-only request look more human than one that supplies the article's key ideas. A context-swap audit then holds each document fixed, and only shows or hides the IDs to the evaluator. The score of the unchanged text swings by a third to half of its scale, and it rises for every document we test, on news and scientific abstracts, across varied LLMs from 3.8B to 753B parameters. The same articles can average 85\% human or 15\% human depending only on which prompt is on record, and even with no prompt at all, the output-only variant rewards the random strings themselves. An exact identity, the credit ledger, explains why. The score is a surprisal-weighted average over the text, so rare strings that the context makes copyable collect the credit, whatever they mean. A two-point bound marks a deeper limit. If the prompt could have been machine-written, every transcript-only method must, in the worst case, miss by half the contribution at stake. Likelihood-based scores alone cannot reliably establish human contribution without evidence of what the person added and how the text was produced.
title: Likelihood Is Not Authorship: Can We Reliably Measure Human Contribution in AI-Assisted Writing?
title_translated: 似然并非作者身份：我们能否可靠衡量AI辅助写作中的人类贡献？
summary_translated: AI文本检测通常关注文本是否由机器撰写。随着AI日益成为写作中不可或缺且被广泛接受的组成部分，更相关的问题不再是‘是否使用了AI’，而是‘有多少内容反映了人类贡献’。一种主流方法通过测量用户提示对最终文本的预测能力来估算这一比例。我们指出该度量极易被操纵。我们引入SPECIFICITY PADDING，仅要求模型复制提示中的几个随机ID，这一操作本身即可使仅提供标题的请求看起来比提供文章核心思想的请求更具‘人类特征’。随后进行上下文交换审计：固定文档内容，仅向评估者展示或隐藏这些ID。未改变的文本得分波动达到其量表的三分之一至一半，且在新闻和科学摘要等各类文本、从3.8B到753B参数的多种LLM上，所有测试文档得分均上升。同一文章根据记录的提示不同，人类贡献评分可平均达85%或仅15%，甚至在无提示的情况下，仅输出变体也会奖励那些随机字符串本身。精确的身份机制——信用账本——解释了原因：该分数是文本上惊喜度加权的平均值，因此只要上下文允许复制，即使毫无意义的稀有字符串也能获得信用。一个两点界限揭示了更深层限制：若提示可能由机器生成，则任何仅基于转录的方法在最坏情况下都可能遗漏一半的贡献。仅依赖似然的评分无法在缺乏人添加内容证据及文本生成方式信息的前提下，可靠地确立人类贡献。

summary: Medical prescribing errors for multimorbid patients, who require complex drug regimens, are a major patient safety concern. These errors often stem from fragmented decision-making across medical specialties, a critical coordination failure that leads to adverse drug events and rehospitalizations. To address this coordination challenge, we introduce PRISMATIC, a multi-agent architecture where specialized agents, each representing a workflow role, collaboratively generate and refine treatment plans. Operating on a blackboard architecture, the system first structures patient information from clinical notes, then iteratively develops safe, rational, and interpretable drug regimens. The agents' collaboration is governed by two novel adaptive coordination mechanisms: (1) Dynamic Self-Updating Weight Adjustment (DSWA), a long-term mechanism that adjusts the influence weights of agents based on historical case outcomes, enabling the system to adapt and trust more reliable specialists over time. (2) Discrepancy Feedback Precise Calibration (DFPC), a short-term mechanism where agents provide iterative feedback to resolve disagreements and eliminate prescription conflicts for the current patient. Experiments on patient records from the MIMIC-IV database show that PRISMATIC significantly reduces drug conflicts, improves prescription coverage, and enhances treatment consistency compared to strong LLM baselines. Our work demonstrates that structuring clinical co-treatment as a multi-agent coordination problem offers a promising path toward safer and more coherent multidisease management.
title: PRISMATIC : Prescription Risk Inspection System for Multi-Agent Treatment Interaction in Clinical Decision-Making
title_translated: PRISMATIC：多智能体治疗交互中的处方风险检查系统，用于临床决策
summary_translated: 对于需复杂药物方案的多重共病患者，处方错误是重大患者安全问题。此类错误常源于跨医学专科的碎片化决策，这种关键的协调失败导致不良药物事件和再入院。为应对这一协调挑战，我们提出PRISMATIC，一种多智能体架构，其中每个代表特定工作流程角色的专用智能体协作生成并优化治疗方案。系统基于黑板架构运行：首先从临床笔记中结构化患者信息，然后迭代生成安全、合理且可解释的药物方案。智能体间的协作由两种新型自适应协调机制驱动：(1) 动态自我更新权重调整（DSWA），一种长期机制，根据历史案例结果调整智能体的影响权重，使系统能随时间适应并信任更可靠的专家；(2) 差异反馈精准校准（DFPC），一种短期机制，智能体通过迭代反馈解决分歧，消除当前患者的处方冲突。在MIMIC-IV数据库的患者记录上进行的实验表明，PRISMATIC显著减少了药物冲突，提升了处方覆盖率，并增强了治疗一致性，优于强基线LLM模型。我们的工作表明，将临床联合治疗结构化为多智能体协调问题，为更安全、更连贯的多疾病管理提供了有前景的路径。

summary: We present Lumen, The open-source model is available at, our submission to the WMT 2026 General Machine Translation Shared Task. We focus on instruction-specialized translation, where systems must produce accurate translations while satisfying fine-grained requirements on style, terminology, and structured output. Lumen follows a four-stage pipeline. First, continued pre-training and supervised fine-tuning jointly strengthen multilingual translation competence and the ability to follow translation-specific instructions, such as terminology, style, and format constraints. Second, we extend the originally offline M^{2}PO preference-optimization framework into an online preference-optimization stage: the current policy samples candidate translations, an LLM judge assigns continuous direct-assessment scores, and the resulting multi-pair preferences are used to update the model. Third, on-policy distillation transfers stronger translation-instruction-following behavior from a larger teacher model to the Qwen3-14B student, improving translation-instruction adherence while retaining a 14B primary translation backbone. Finally, structure-aware inference and postprocessing preserve required formats, while selective repair addresses clear structural or decoding failures before submission. We participate in 23 translation directions. Under an absolute 1--5 LLM-judge rubric that evaluates translation-instruction following and translation quality separately, Lumen reaches an overall mean score of 4.60. Despite using a 14B translation backbone, it achieves performance comparable to leading proprietary systems in both translation quality and translation-instruction following.
title: Qwen-MT-Lumen at WMT2026: Instruction-Specialized Translation via Quality-Aware Training and On-Policy Distillation
title_translated: Qwen-MT-Lumen 参与 WMT2026：基于质量感知训练与策略内蒸馏的指令特化翻译
summary_translated: 我们介绍Lumen，这是提交给WMT 2026通用机器翻译共享任务的开源模型。我们聚焦于指令特化翻译，即系统必须在满足风格、术语和结构化输出等细粒度要求的同时，生成准确的翻译。Lumen采用四阶段流程：第一阶段，持续预训练与监督微调共同增强多语言翻译能力及遵循翻译特定指令（如术语、风格、格式约束）的能力；第二阶段，我们将原本离线的M²PO偏好优化框架扩展为在线偏好优化阶段：当前策略采样候选翻译，LLM裁判给出连续直接评估分数，由此产生的多对偏好用于更新模型；第三阶段，策略内蒸馏将更大教师模型更强的翻译指令遵循行为迁移到Qwen3-14B学生模型，提升翻译指令遵循能力，同时保留14B主翻译骨干；第四阶段，结构感知推理与后处理保留所需格式，选择性修复明显的结构或解码失败后再提交。我们在23个翻译方向参与竞赛。在独立评估翻译指令遵循与翻译质量的1–5分LLM裁判评分体系下，Lumen总体平均得分为4.60。尽管使用14B翻译骨干，其在翻译质量和指令遵循方面均达到与领先专有系统相当的性能。

summary: Biomedical multi-hop reasoning over knowledge graphs requires identifying a semantically valid relation sequence that supports the answer. Existing methods can retrieve correct answers, yet often rank them poorly within a large pool of seemingly relevant candidates. Even when a correct answer is retrieved, its associated evidence and reasoning path may fail to support the relation composition required by the question. We term this disconnect between answer reachability and evidential validity the reachable-but-invalid problem. We present ReSemReason, which shares a question-induced distribution over typed, directed relation schemas between candidate discovery and evidence selection. Schema compatibility guides graph search; ReSemAttn then uses relation-conditioned key/value projections and an uncertainty-weighted path prior to attend to candidate-specific evidence. A separate absolute-support score complements normalized attention when all retrieved paths are weak. The reported experiments on BioHopR, PrimeKGQA, and MedReason show improvements in answer ranking and answer-set quality. Path-discrimination analyses examine the distinction between endpoint correctness and evidential support. We also specify matched controls for search, attention, and schema uncertainty.
title: Beyond Reachability: A Relation-Semantic Reasoning Framework for Biomedical Multi-hop QA
title_translated: 超越可达性：一种用于生物医学多跳问答的关系语义推理框架
summary_translated: 在知识图谱上进行生物医学多跳推理需要识别出支持答案的语义有效关系序列。现有方法虽然能检索到正确答案，但在大量看似相关的候选答案中排名往往不佳。即使正确答案被检索到，其关联的证据和推理路径也可能无法支持问题所要求的关系组合。我们将这种答案可达性与证据有效性之间的脱节称为‘可达但无效’问题。我们提出了ReSemReason，该方法在候选发现和证据选择之间共享由问题诱导的类型化有向关系模式分布。模式兼容性指导图搜索；ReSemAttn则利用关系条件化的键/值投影和不确定性加权路径先验来关注特定候选的证据。一个独立的绝对支持得分在所有检索路径较弱时补充归一化注意力。在BioHopR、PrimeKGQA和MedReason上的实验表明，该方法在答案排序和答案集质量方面均有提升。路径区分性分析考察了终点正确性与证据支持之间的区别。我们还设计了匹配的对照实验以评估搜索、注意力和模式不确定性的影响。

summary: Visible reasoning traces of Chinese reasoning-oriented LLMs are typically written in modern vernacular Chinese, which may be verbose under limited decoding budgets. We ask whether the linguistic register of reasoning can be used to improve efficiency. We propose Wenyan Thinking, which emits intermediate reasoning in Classical Chinese (wenyanwen) while retaining a short direct-answer output. Starting from modern-Chinese reasoning traces, we rewrite only the reasoning field into wenyan and fine-tune Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 on the rewritten supervision. To distinguish register shift from generic compression, we construct a compact modern-Chinese control using the same source data, teacher family, base model, and SFT recipe. Across budget-sensitive evaluations on MMLU-ProX-Lite-ZH, CEVAL, and AGIEval-CN, Wenyan Thinking substantially reduces reasoning length and missing-answer rates under constrained decoding. Compact rewriting explains much of the efficiency gain, while wenyan consistently outperforms the compact modern-Chinese control on the primary benchmark and remains competitive across the additional benchmarks. These results identify linguistic register as a practical design axis for efficient visible reasoning in Chinese LLMs.
title: Does the Linguistic Register of Thinking Matter? Wenyan as a Compact Reasoning Register for Chinese LLMs
title_translated: 思维的语言风格重要吗？文言文作为中文大模型的紧凑推理风格
summary_translated: 中文推理导向的大模型通常使用现代白话文书写可见的推理过程，这在有限的解码预算下可能显得冗长。我们探讨语言风格是否可用于提升效率。我们提出文言文思维（Wenyan Thinking），即在保留简短直接答案输出的同时，以文言文形式生成中间推理步骤。从现代汉语推理轨迹出发，仅将推理部分重写为文言文，并在重写后的监督信号上微调Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507模型。为区分语言风格转换与通用压缩效果，我们构建了一个基于相同源数据、教师家族、基础模型和SFT流程的紧凑现代汉语对照组。在MMLU-ProX-Lite-ZH、CEVAL和AGIEval-CN等对预算敏感的评估中，文言文思维显著减少了推理长度和漏答率。紧凑重写解释了大部分效率提升，而文言文在主基准上始终优于紧凑现代汉语对照组，并在其他基准上保持竞争力。这些结果表明，语言风格是实现中文大模型高效可见推理的一个实用设计维度。

summary: Scenario-based validation is essential for automated road vehicles but cannot cover the full variability of openworld traffic. We present MakSafe, a formal spatiotemporal framework for specifying and checking road vehicle safety rules through semantic zones, action-based forecasting, and trace-tree reasoning, avoiding uniform time discretization. We formalize the road network, vehicle states, and occupancy zones, then build executable rules for front-vehicle identification and timeto-collision (TTC) verification. The evaluation combines a tracedependent case study with a scalability benchmark over traffic density (N ), horizon (H), and branch factor (B). MakSafe yields branch-specific verdicts, deriving safe and unsafe outcomes from the same initial scene, and re-evaluates a scenario after a control update. A single rule check stays well below a millisecond across the reported sweep, and longer horizons slow the TTC check.
title: MakSafe: A Spatiotemporal Semantic Framework for Formal Specification and Compliance Checking of Road Vehicle Safety Rules
title_translated: MakSafe：面向道路车辆安全规则的形式化时空语义框架
summary_translated: 基于场景的验证对于自动驾驶车辆至关重要，但无法覆盖开放交通环境中的全部变异性。我们提出MakSafe，一种通过语义区域、基于动作的预测和迹树推理的形式化时空框架，用于指定和检查道路车辆安全规则，避免统一的时间离散化。我们形式化了道路网络、车辆状态和占用区域，进而构建了前车识别和碰撞时间（TTC）验证的可执行规则。评估结合了依赖轨迹的案例研究与针对交通密度（N）、预测范围（H）和分支因子（B）的可扩展性基准。MakSafe能够产生分支特定的判断结果，从同一初始场景推导出安全与不安全结论，并在控制更新后重新评估场景。单次规则检查在报告范围内始终低于1毫秒，而更长的预测范围会减慢TTC检查速度。

summary: Interpreting an ambiguous utterance in real-world interactions often requires context beyond a single utterance. When the utterance refers to objects in a visual scene, it is necessary to maintain and update the set of plausible referents as context accumulates, without assuming that the available information identifies a unique object. However, prior work on interactive visual grounding, which localizes objects referred to by linguistic expressions, has focused on identifying a unique object once sufficient dialogue context becomes available. To address this gap, we propose Candidate Set Visual Grounding (CSVG), a task for estimating the set of objects consistent with the given dialogue context. We further introduce CandVG, a benchmark that evaluates how the candidate set changes across dialogue turns. Our evaluation of vision-language models shows that stronger visual grounding capability does not necessarily yield better CSVG performance. In particular, models have difficulty predicting the complete candidate set, owing to challenges in candidate generation and premature commitment to a small set of candidates in early turns. Nevertheless, we find that this limitation can be partially mitigated in the evaluated large-scale models using instructions designed for CSVG.
title: Recognizing Dialogue Ambiguity via Candidate Set Visual Grounding
