title_translated: RM-OPD：基于策略内蒸馏的生成式奖励模型
summary_translated: 混合领域偏好数据上的强化学习（Mix-RL）已成为训练通用生成式奖励模型（GRMs）的主流方法。然而，Mix-RL面临两个关键瓶颈：由结果奖励引起的奖励稀疏性，以及联合优化异构能力导致的跨领域干扰，二者共同造成能力获取不平衡和普遍的奖励欺骗问题。受策略内蒸馏（OPD）在多领域能力整合中成功应用的启发，我们提出RM-OPD（通过策略内蒸馏进行奖励建模），一种两阶段框架，将专家能力获取与能力集成分离。首先，通过单领域GRPO微调培育领域专用教师模型，使每个专家在独立状态下达到性能上限；随后通过（i）路由策略内蒸馏，为学生生成的批评提供密集的符号化token级监督；（ii）领域贡献重加权，重新分配token指导以匹配目标领域占比，防止特定领域主导优化；以及（iii）可选的标准上下文蒸馏，使教师基于领域特定评估标准进行条件化，从而增强token级监督。在多个奖励建模基准和两种基础模型上，RM-OPD始终优于原始Mix-RL及其他强基线，实现整体更优性能，并表现出显著的“教师超越”效应。这些结果确立了RM-OPD作为构建通用GRMs的有前景范式。

summary: Full-duplex speech systems must decide when to enter, hold, or relinquish the conversational floor, even as multiple speakers overlap or backchannel without taking it. Existing evaluations study dyadic turn-taking or end-to-end agent behavior, but lack a unified, controlled evaluation of genuine floor transitions against confusable non-events in multi-party settings. We introduce MultiPartyTurnBench (MPTB), a benchmark of 240 synthetically generated, channel-separated conversations spanning two to five speakers and six interaction types. MPTB evaluates two complementary tasks: End-of-Turn (EOT) detection distinguishes genuine turn completion from temporary holds, while Interruption (INT) detection distinguishes successful floor takeovers from non-floor-taking speech. Exact event-conditioned annotations enable causal evaluation using false-positive-constrained recall and signed latency. Across acoustic, semantic, and turn-projection baselines, we find a stark asymmetry: learned systems achieve 82.5-92.6% EOT recall at 4.3-11.8% false-positive rates, while INT detection suffers from missed takeovers or excessive false activations. This asymmetry extends to five full-duplex agents which achieve 86.1-95.8% balanced accuracy on turn entry, yet perform near chance (46.9-54.7%) on selective interruption handling. Gemini-3.8-Live yields to 97.7% of backchannels, whereas MiniCPM-o-4.5 yields to only 1.4% of genuine interruptions. These findings establish selective floor control as a distinct, unresolved challenge for reliable multi-party voice interaction.
title: MultiPartyTurnBench: Benchmarking Floor Control in Multi-Party Spoken Dialogue
title_translated: MultiPartyTurnBench：多参与者语音对话中的发言权控制基准测试
summary_translated: 全双工语音系统必须决定何时进入、保持或放弃对话发言权，即使存在多个说话人重叠或仅作回应而不占据发言权的情况。现有评估主要关注二人对话轮换或端到端代理行为，缺乏在多参与者场景下对真实发言权转换与混淆非事件进行统一、可控的评估。我们引入MultiPartyTurnBench（MPTB），一个包含240个合成生成、信道分离的对话的基准，涵盖2至5名说话人及六种交互类型。MPTB评估两个互补任务：句末检测（EOT）区分真实的发言结束与临时停顿；打断检测（INT）区分成功的发言权夺取与非发言权夺取的言语。精确事件条件标注支持使用受限假阳性召回率和带符号延迟进行因果评估。在声学、语义和轮次投影基线中，我们发现显著不对称性：学习系统在4.3%-11.8%假阳性率下实现82.5%-92.6%的EOT召回率，而INT检测则存在大量遗漏夺取或过度误激活。这种不对称性延伸至五个全双工代理，其发言权进入的平衡准确率达86.1%-95.8%，但在选择性打断处理上表现接近随机（46.9%-54.7%）。Gemini-3.8-Live对回话响应率为97.7%，而MiniCPM-o-4.5仅对1.4%的真实打断作出响应。这些发现确立了选择性发言权控制作为可靠多参与者语音交互中一个独特且未解决的挑战。

summary: Banks rely on extensive internal policy frameworks to ensure that corporate lending decisions comply with regulatory requirements and internal risk standards. Reviewing loan applications against these policies is a largely manual and knowledge-intensive process, which can lead to overlooked policy violations or exceptions. This report presents a prototype of an LLM-based policy checker that automatically verifies loan applications against internal lending policies.   The proposed approach follows a two-step architecture. First, compliance-relevant rules are automatically extracted from policy documents and converted into structured, machine-readable representations. Second, loan applications are evaluated against the extracted rules to identify policy exceptions, non-compliant findings, missing information, and cases requiring manual review.   Evaluation results demonstrate that the rule extraction process is highly stable across multiple runs and consistently captures rules identified as critical by a domain expert. When evaluated on 11 real loan applications with known policy exceptions, the system successfully detected the majority of these exceptions and identified additional compliance issues that had previously been overlooked during manual reviews. While the approach produces false positives and cannot fully replace human judgement, the results indicate that LLM-based policy compliance verification can provide valuable support in the loan application verification process by highlighting potential compliance risks.
title: LLM-Based Policy Compliance Verification of Loan Applications
title_translated: 基于大语言模型的贷款申请政策合规性验证
summary_translated: 银行依赖复杂的内部政策框架来确保企业贷款决策符合监管要求和内部风险标准。将贷款申请与这些政策进行比对是一个高度人工化且知识密集的过程，可能导致政策违规或例外被忽略。本报告展示了一个基于大语言模型的政策检查器原型，可自动验证贷款申请是否符合内部贷款政策。所提方法采用两步架构：首先，从政策文档中自动提取与合规相关的规则，并转换为结构化、机器可读的形式；其次，将贷款申请与提取出的规则进行比对，识别政策例外、不合规项、信息缺失以及需人工复核的情形。评估结果显示，规则提取过程在多次运行中具有高度稳定性，并能一致捕捉领域专家认定的关键规则。在11个已知存在政策例外的真实贷款申请上评估时，该系统成功检测出大部分例外，并发现了此前人工审查中被忽略的其他合规问题。尽管该方法会产生误报且无法完全替代人类判断，但结果表明基于大语言模型的政策合规性验证可在贷款申请审核过程中提供有价值的辅助，突出潜在的合规风险。

summary: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) has shown strong effectiveness for text-based LLMs and LLM systems, but its application to audio-visual understanding systems requires suitable textual interfaces through which multimodal reasoning can be exposed to text-based optimizers. We investigate how the design of textual interfaces affects prompt optimization for multimodal reasoning, on the audio-visual question answering task. We compare three interface designs, including a direct inference system consisting of a single omni-modal large language model (OmniLLM), a captioner-reasoner system, and an agentic architecture in which a primary agent orchestrates subagent OmniLLMs. Experiments with Qwen3-Omni and Gemini show that direct prompt optimization provides model-dependent gains; the captioner-reasoner system and the agentic system expose more interpretable optimization interfaces but are harder to optimize, where error analysis of cases affected by optimization is conducted. Our study highlights textual interface design as an important factor in making prompt optimization effective for omni-modal reasoning systems. Our implementation details are specified in GitHub repo.
title: Designing Textual Interfaces To Enhance Llm Reasoning On Audio-Visual Question Answering
title_translated: 设计文本接口以增强大语言模型在音视频问答中的推理能力
summary_translated: 自动提示优化（APO）在文本型大语言模型及其系统中表现出强大效果，但其在音视频理解系统中的应用需要合适的文本接口，以便将多模态推理暴露给基于文本的优化器。我们研究了文本接口设计如何影响音视频问答任务中提示优化的效果。我们比较了三种接口设计：包括一个由单一全模态大语言模型（OmniLLM）组成的直接推理系统、一个描述生成-推理系统，以及一个由主代理协调子代理OmniLLMs的智能体架构。在Qwen3-Omni和Gemini上的实验表明，直接提示优化带来模型依赖性的提升；而描述生成-推理系统和智能体系统提供了更具可解释性的优化接口，但更难优化，同时对受优化影响案例进行了错误分析。我们的研究强调，文本接口设计是使提示优化在全模态推理系统中有效的关键因素。具体实现细节见GitHub仓库。

summary: Linters are widely used in code maintenance and real-time IDE editing to surface lint alerts related to performance, style, error-prone, and other patterns in source files. However, existing code benchmarks do not explicitly evaluate linter-guided file refactoring, where models must reduce lint alerts in source files with correct initial functionality while satisfying functionality preservation. We introduce LintEval, a multilingual benchmark for linter-guided file refactoring across C++, Python, and Java, comprising 13,061 programs with correct initial functionality and 171,662 lint alerts extracted using language-specific linters. LintEval jointly evaluates functionality preservation, lint alert reduction, new alert avoidance, and edit minimality. Experiments reveal a persistent trade-off: closed-source commercial models reach up to 90.4% Reduction@P but achieve only 67.1%-68.3% Pass@1, while several open-source small models show low or negative Reduction@P. A controlled fine-tuning study further shows that supervision format matters: refactoring-oriented SFT raises Qwen2.5-Coder-7B Reduction@P from 24.7% to 76.0%. LintEval enables controlled evaluation of models that improve source files under functionality preservation.
title: LintEval: Benchmarking LLMs on Linter-Guided File Refactoring
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. Code available at this https URL
title_translated: LintEval：基于lint工具引导的文件重构的大语言模型基准测试
summary_translated: lint工具广泛用于代码维护和实时IDE编辑中，以揭示源文件中与性能、风格、易错等相关的警告。然而，现有代码基准并未明确评估lint引导的文件重构任务，即模型需在保持初始功能正确性的前提下减少源文件中的lint警告并满足功能保留要求。我们引入LintEval，一个跨C++、Python和Java的多语言基准，包含13,061个初始功能正确的程序和使用语言特定lint工具提取的171,662个lint警告。LintEval联合评估功能保留、lint警告减少、新警告避免和修改最小性。实验揭示出持续存在的权衡：闭源商业模型最高可实现90.4%的Reduction@P，但Pass@1仅为67.1%-68.3%；而多个开源小型模型则表现出低或负的Reduction@P。一项受控微调研究进一步表明，监督格式至关重要：面向重构的SFT将Qwen2.5-Coder-7B的Reduction@P从24.7%提升至76.0%。LintEval实现了在功能保留条件下对改进源文件的模型进行受控评估。

summary: Molecular design is often formulated as an optimization problem over existing molecular spaces. However, molecular optimization and the discovery of structurally distinct replacement molecules represent two fundamentally different search problems. LLM-based molecular design agents typically perform the former, conducting local refinement within the neighborhood of existing structures to improve target properties through structural modifications. In contrast, the latter requires exploration of a broader chemical space to discover molecules with entirely different scaffolds while preserving the functional characteristics of reference molecules. We propose MolHop, an agentic framework for cross-scaffold molecular discovery that enables models to navigate and edit within a pre-organized chemical space. MolHop organizes approximately 1.6 million molecular scaffolds from commercial molecules into a coarse-to-fine hierarchical action space. The agent selects new exploration regions through scaffold navigation actions and adjusts candidate properties through molecular editing. The framework maintains historical trajectory memory to support long-horizon search processes. On drug molecule and commercial compound tasks, connecting Grok-4.6 and DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1 to the MolHop framework substantially improves their cross-scaffold joint success rates. We develop MolHop-9B through agentic reinforcement learning, and MolHop-9B outperforms generative baselines including GPT-5.6-sol, Claude-5-Opus, and Gemini-3.1-Pro, while generating candidate molecules with larger scaffold differences from the reference molecules. These results demonstrate that effective molecular discovery beyond the traditional optimization paradigm requires structured chemical and action spaces, enabling agents to explore new structural regions rather than merely refine existing molecules.
title: MolHop: Scaffold-Hopping Molecular Design with Agentic Reinforcement Learning
title_translated: MolHop：基于智能体强化学习的骨架跳跃分子设计
summary_translated: 分子设计通常被建模为在现有分子空间中的优化问题。然而，分子优化与发现结构上截然不同的替代分子代表了两种根本不同的搜索问题。基于大语言模型的分子设计智能体通常仅执行前者，在现有结构的邻域内进行局部优化以改进目标属性。相比之下，后者需要探索更广泛的化学空间，以发现具有完全不同骨架的分子，同时保持参考分子的功能特性。我们提出了MolHop，一种用于跨骨架分子发现的智能体框架，使模型能够在预组织的化学空间中导航和编辑。MolHop将约160万种来自商业分子的分子骨架组织成从粗到细的层次化动作空间。智能体通过骨架导航动作选择新的探索区域，并通过分子编辑调整候选属性。该框架维护历史轨迹记忆，以支持长时程搜索过程。在药物分子和商业化合物任务中，将Grok-4.6和DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1连接到MolHop框架后，其跨骨架联合成功率显著提升。我们通过智能体强化学习开发了MolHop-9B，该模型在生成与参考分子骨架差异更大的候选分子方面，优于包括GPT-5.6-sol、Claude-5-Opus和Gemini-3.1-Pro在内的生成基线模型。结果表明，超越传统优化范式的有效分子发现需要结构化的化学与动作空间，使智能体能够探索新结构区域，而不仅仅是优化现有分子。

summary: We introduce SEA-HELM Audio, a Southeast Asian (SEA) multilingual evaluation framework that extends the text-based SEA-HELM benchmark to assess performance degradation in cascaded automatic speech recognition and large language model (ASR-LLM) pipelines. Using synthesized speech, we compare speech-input and text-input performance across five languages (Chinese, English, Malay, Indonesian, and Tamil) on multiple-choice reasoning and instruction-following tasks. We evaluate open-weight and commercial ASR-LLM systems using identical verifiers and quantify the speech gap as the difference between text and speech accuracy. Results show substantial degradation, with accuracy drops of 9.00 to 18.50 percentage points for multiple-choice reasoning and 20.00 to 42.86 points for instruction following. Tamil exhibits the largest degradation, exceeding 40 percentage points. Our findings highlight the limitations of text-only benchmarks in predicting voice-agent reliability and demonstrate the value of SEA-HELM Audio for evaluating multilingual voice-agent systems.
title: SEA-HELM Audio: Evaluating Multilingual ASR-LLM Pipeline Performance Across SEA-HELM Subsets
title_translated: SEA-HELM Audio：跨SEA-HELM子集评估多语言ASR-LLM流水线性能
summary_translated: 我们提出了SEA-HELM Audio，一个面向东南亚（SEA）地区的多语言评估框架，将原有的文本基准扩展至语音输入场景，用于评估级联式自动语音识别与大语言模型（ASR-LLM）流水线中的性能退化。通过合成语音，我们在五种语言（中文、英文、马来语、印尼语和泰米尔语）上对比了语音输入与文本输入在多项选择推理和指令遵循任务中的表现。我们使用相同的验证器评估开源与商用ASR-LLM系统，并量化语音差距（即文本与语音准确率之差）。结果显示性能显著下降，多项选择推理任务准确率下降9.00至18.50个百分点，指令遵循任务下降20.00至42.86个百分点。泰米尔语的退化最为严重，超过40个百分点。我们的研究揭示了仅依赖文本基准在预测语音代理可靠性方面的局限性，并证明了SEA-HELM Audio在评估多语言语音代理系统方面的价值。

summary: LLMs absorb vast knowledge from training data, yet their inherently probabilistic nature offers no guarantee that this knowledge will surface in their outputs. To bridge this gap, Knowledge Extraction Enhancement (KEE) techniques such as activation steering, decoding adjustments, and prompting modify inference, potentially reinforcing existing predictions or surfacing less accessible answers. Yet their evaluations centered on aggregate accuracy, which obscures diverse effects by collapsing recovered failures and disrupted successes into a single score. We introduce MAPLE, a unified framework for characterizing how KEE techniques affect parametric knowledge extraction. Its diagnostic metrics disentangle these effects at the surface, probability, and beyond-sampling levels by measuring answer recovery and disruption, gold-token rank shifts on unrecovered failures, and recovery of answers missed by fixed-budget sampling. We evaluate six KEE techniques spanning decoding, activation steering, and prompting across three model families: OLMo2, Qwen2.5, and Llama3. Our analysis reveals distinct effects and trade-offs across techniques, highlighting the value of MAPLE for understanding and comparing KEE beyond aggregate accuracy.
title: MAPLE: A Multi-Axis Parametric Knowledge Extraction Lens for LLM Evaluation
title_translated: MAPLE：用于LLM评估的多轴参数化知识提取透镜
summary_translated: 大语言模型从训练数据中吸收了海量知识，但其固有的概率性质无法保证这些知识能在输出中显现。为弥合这一鸿沟，知识提取增强（KEE）技术如激活引导、解码调整和提示工程等会修改推理过程，可能强化已有预测或揭示较难获取的答案。然而，现有评估方法集中于整体准确率，将恢复失败与破坏成功合并为单一指标，掩盖了不同影响。我们提出MAPLE，一个统一框架，用于刻画KEE技术对参数化知识提取的影响。其诊断指标在表面、概率及采样之外层面解耦这些效应，分别测量答案恢复与破坏、未恢复失败中的黄金标记排名变化，以及固定预算采样遗漏答案的恢复情况。我们在三种模型族（OLMo2、Qwen2.5、Llama3）上评估了六种涵盖解码、激活引导和提示的KEE技术。分析揭示了各技术间的独特影响与权衡，凸显了MAPLE在超越整体准确率理解与比较KEE技术方面的价值。

summary: In Theory-of-Mind (ToM) reasoning, large language models may correctly infer the agent's mental state but fail to use that inference when predicting or judging the agent's subsequent actions. In this work, we investigate whether explicitly connecting perception, belief, and action with rules improves ToM reasoning. We generate concise \textit{if--then} rules that express relations between perception to action and use Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to train Qwen2.5 and Llama3 models across four ToM benchmarks. GRPO with rule generation outperforms prompting, supervised fine-tuning, and think reasoning. Moreover, rules generated by larger models ($\geq$3B) provide transferable knowledge that improves downstream performance of GPT-4o-mini. These findings suggest that explicit rules help models bridge the reasoning gap in ToM and support knowledge transfer across models.
title: Learning Perception to Action Rules through Reinforcement Learning for Theory-of-Mind Reasoning
title_translated: 通过强化学习学习感知到行动规则以实现心智理论推理
summary_translated: 在心智理论（ToM）推理中，大语言模型可能正确推断出代理的心理状态，但在预测或判断该代理后续行为时却未能利用这一推断。本文探讨是否通过显式建立感知、信念与行动之间的规则能改善ToM推理。我们生成简洁的“如果-那么”规则来表达感知到行动的关系，并使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）在四个ToM基准上训练Qwen2.5和Llama3模型。使用规则生成的GRPO在性能上优于提示、监督微调和思维链推理。此外，由更大模型（≥3B）生成的规则具备可迁移性，能提升GPT-4o-mini的下游表现。这些发现表明，显式规则有助于模型弥合ToM中的推理鸿沟，并支持跨模型的知识迁移。

summary: Video large language models (Video LLMs) often generate responses unsupported by the input video. Contrastive decoding (CD) can mitigate these hallucinations, but its effectiveness depends on how the negative branch weakens visual evidence. Existing methods rely on predefined perturbations or masking guided by question reconstruction, offering limited control over the model's visual reliance during answer generation. We introduce Attention-guided Representation Perturbation for Contrastive Decoding (ARP-CD), a training-free framework for constructing contrastive negatives directly in representation space. ARP-CD uses the attention mass assigned to visual tokens at the answer-prediction position to guide bounded gradient updates of the language model's input visual hidden states. These updates reduce visual attention and produce a negative input, whose predictions are contrasted with those of the original branch throughout generation. Experiments across four Video LLMs and four benchmarks show that ARP-CD outperforms representative training-free baselines in most model--benchmark settings, reducing hallucinations while improving general video understanding. Further analyses show that attention-guided perturbation directions improve negative quality and that the resulting negatives provide effective contrastive references for correcting the original predictions.
title: Mitigating Video Hallucinations via Attention-Guided Representation Perturbation
title_translated: 通过注意力引导的表示扰动缓解视频幻觉
summary_translated: 视频大语言模型（Video LLMs）经常生成与输入视频无关的回答。对比解码（CD）可缓解此类幻觉，但其有效性取决于负样本分支如何削弱视觉证据。现有方法依赖预定义扰动或基于问题重构的掩码，对生成过程中模型视觉依赖性的控制有限。我们提出注意力引导的表示扰动用于对比解码（ARP-CD），一种无需训练的框架，直接在表示空间构建对比负样本。ARP-CD利用在答案预测位置分配给视觉标记的注意力质量，指导语言模型输入视觉隐藏状态的有界梯度更新。这些更新降低视觉注意力，生成负样本输入，其预测在整个生成过程中与原始分支进行对比。在四个Video LLM和四个基准上的实验表明，ARP-CD在大多数模型-基准组合中优于代表性无训练基线，减少幻觉的同时提升通用视频理解能力。进一步分析显示，注意力引导的扰动方向提升了负样本质量，且生成的负样本为纠正原始预测提供了有效的对比参考。

summary: Language captures only a subset of the perceptions, intuitions and intents that form meaning between speakers. What, then, are the limits of language? We take steps towards measuring this in LLMs as follows: for a set of concepts, we measure how well each concept can be transmitted between two LLMs as their capabilities scale. This requires novel measurement tools: (1) optimal messages: we introduce a prompt optimization algorithm that beats existing algorithms by up to 14% on benchmarks and accurately estimates prompt upper bounds. (2) A transmission measure: the sender is asked to label text; the receiver then tries to recover the sender's prompt, and recovery is measured; we find this correlates strongly with human label error. With these measures, we use observational scaling laws to study how transmissibility of a concept, conveyed with optimal messages, increases as transmitter and receiver capacity grows: does it asymptote below or above a threshold? Measuring 1.2k concepts in eight domains, we find concepts that (a) can be fully articulated; these concepts usually depend on local patterns, e.g. "joke ends with surprise"; (b) might be articulated by future, stronger models; these rely on whole-text structural patterns, e.g. "story's worldbuilding coherence"; (c) concepts that face articulability limits; these concepts' meaning, we find, is tied to identity and social-group awareness, e.g. "comic voice". Interesting, these same concepts are not all challenging for humans: humans have moderate-to-high levels of agreement in 76% of concepts that LLMs struggle with; articulation limits, we find, are executor relative. Finally, we characterize the nature of improvement in each case: while recoverable concepts can be articulated through definitions and explanations, irrecoverable concepts cannot be transmitted, even with examples, and might require novel learning mechanisms.
title: Articulation Upper Bounds for Language Models
title_translated: 语言模型的表达上限
summary_translated: 语言仅捕捉了说话者之间形成意义的感知、直觉和意图的一部分。那么，语言的极限是什么？我们通过以下方式对大语言模型（LLM）中的这一问题进行了初步探索：针对一组概念，测量随着模型能力的提升，这些概念在两个LLM之间传输的效果。这需要新的测量工具：（1）最优消息：我们提出了一种提示优化算法，在基准测试中比现有算法提升高达14%，并能准确估计提示的上限；（2）传输度量：发送方被要求标注文本，接收方尝试恢复发送方的提示，通过恢复效果进行评估；我们发现该指标与人类标注误差高度相关。利用观测缩放定律，我们研究了在使用最优消息时，随着发送方和接收方容量增长，概念可传输性的变化趋势：其是否在某个阈值以下或以上趋于稳定？我们在八个领域中测量了1200个概念，发现存在三类概念：（a）可以完全表达的概念，通常依赖局部模式，如“笑话以意外结尾”；（b）未来更强模型可能表达的概念，依赖整体文本结构模式，如“故事的世界构建一致性”；（c）面临表达极限的概念，其意义与身份和群体意识相关，如“喜剧语气”。有趣的是，这些对LLM具有挑战性的概念，并非对人类都困难：在LLM难以处理的概念中，人类在76%的情况下有中等至高水平的一致性；我们发现表达极限是执行者相关的。最后，我们分析了每种情况下的改进本质：可恢复的概念可通过定义和解释实现表达，而不可恢复的概念即使提供示例也无法传输，可能需要新型学习机制。

summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves reasoning in language models, but scalar outcomes provide coarse supervision over response trajectories. Self-distillation offers denser token-level guidance by comparing an unassisted policy with a feedback-informed self-teacher, yet the teacher evolves with the student, creating unstable targets and motivating additional regularization. We introduce Function-Space Policy Optimization (FSPO), a single-policy framework that combines current privileged adaptation with function-space temporal consolidation. FSPO stores sparse historical next-token distributions as fixed temporal targets, providing temporal separation without maintaining a persistent teacher model. It further introduces privileged disagreement correction to explicitly suppress locally overvalued actions, reliability-adaptive grounding that strengthens reference supervision when self-generated evidence repeatedly fails, and quality and coverage-aware temporal memory that retains verified behaviors and improves privileged demonstrations. Across reasoning and tool-use benchmarks, FSPO achieves the highest average accuracy under a 5-hour training budget, improving over the strongest baseline by approximately 4% points on average while reducing peak memory from about 70 GB to 56 GB on Olmo3-7B-Instruct.
title: Function-Space Temporal Self-Distillation for Policy Optimization
comment: Aryan Das, Vinay Kumar Verma: Equal Contributions. Under Review
title_translated: 函数空间时间自蒸馏用于策略优化
summary_translated: 带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）提升了语言模型的推理能力，但标量结果仅提供粗粒度的响应轨迹监督。自蒸馏通过比较无辅助策略与反馈驱动的自我教师策略，提供了更密集的逐标记级指导，但教师随学生演化，导致目标不稳定，促使额外正则化。我们提出函数空间策略优化（FSPO），一种单策略框架，结合当前特权适应与函数空间时间整合。FSPO将稀疏的历史下一标记分布作为固定的时间目标存储，实现时间分离而不需维持持续的教师模型。它进一步引入特权分歧修正，显式抑制局部高估动作；可靠性自适应定位，在自我生成证据反复失败时增强参考监督；以及质量与覆盖感知的时间记忆，保留已验证行为并改进特权示范。在推理和工具使用基准测试中，FSPO在5小时训练预算下达到最高平均准确率，相比最强基线平均提升约4个百分点，同时将Olmo3-7B-Instruct上的峰值内存从约70 GB降至56 GB。

summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) changes logit margins among non-target tokens at teacher-forced prefixes. Matching a local reference distribution keeps those probabilities and also penalizes margin expansions. We ask whether a soft auxiliary can preserve selected local non-target margin relations without freezing that distribution. We introduce \textbf{Selective Rank-Preserving SFT (SRP-SFT)}, a soft margin target: a hinge on reference-scaled lower bounds for pairs from the reference's top-$K$ non-target tokens, applied at fixed teacher-forced prefixes. The hinge stops once the requested bound is met. We derive the KL cost of violating a margin, characterize the feasible region and its conditional utility, and give a finite-step condition for reducing aggregate violations. In one-epoch experiments on Qwen3-4B-Base and UltraFeedback, this target raises MATH-500 and code-generation scores over CE and LP-SFT at all three training seeds. At seed 1234, MATH-500 pass@1 rises from 49.56\% to 54.56\% and the four-metric code mean rises from 65.91\% to 69.50\% relative to LP-SFT. Ranking controls, held-out cache diagnostics, sensitivity sweeps, and six additional backbones show where these score changes appear.
title: Beyond Distribution Matching: Selective Margin Preservation for Supervised Fine-Tuning
title_translated: 超越分布匹配：监督微调中的选择性边际保持
summary_translated: 监督微调（SFT）会改变教师强制前缀中非目标标记之间的logit边际。匹配局部参考分布可保持这些概率并惩罚边际扩展。我们探讨是否可以通过软辅助目标，在不冻结分布的前提下保持选定的局部非目标边际关系。我们提出**选择性排序保持SFT（SRP-SFT）**，一种软边际目标：在固定教师强制前缀上，对参考分布中top-K非目标标记对施加基于参考缩放的下界铰链约束，一旦满足请求边界即停止。我们推导了违反边际的KL代价，刻画可行区域及其条件效用，并给出减少累积违规的有限步条件。在Qwen3-4B-Base和UltraFeedback上的一轮次实验中，该目标在所有三个训练种子下均优于交叉熵（CE）和LP-SFT，MATH-500和代码生成得分均有提升。在种子1234下，MATH-500 pass@1从49.56%提升至54.56%，四指标代码平均得分从65.91%提升至69.50%。通过排名控制、缓存诊断、敏感性扫描及六种额外骨干网络验证，明确了得分变化出现的位置。

summary: Reinforcement learning provides a direct mechanism for optimizing task objectives in large language model-driven agents, but task rewards are typically sparse trajectory-level signals that only evaluate task success, without directly supervising action-conditioned environment transitions, leaving the model with limited explicit understanding of action consequences and environment dynamics. Recent work introduces auxiliary supervision through policy and world modeling co-training, yet typically treats complete environmental observations uniformly as world modeling targets, overlooking the varying decision relevance of observation content. We propose DGS-WM (Decision-Guided Selective World Modeling), a decision-guided policy-world modeling co-training approach for language agents. DGS-WM employs a Decision-Guided Observation Selection component that filters observation units with decision value as world modeling targets based on their support for subsequent policy responses, and a Confidence-Adaptive Weighting component that adaptively adjusts supervision strength according to the model's prediction confidence on selected targets. Together, these components form a decision-aware auxiliary world modeling loss, jointly optimized with the RL loss on the same policy model. Across multiple benchmarks covering single-hop/multi-hop question answering and interactive web tasks, DGS-WM achieves consistent improvements under different model scales and RL algorithms, demonstrating more stable and effective performance compared to full-observation world modeling methods.
title: Model What Matters: Decision-Guided Selective World Modeling for Language Agents
comment: Core implementation included as ancillary files
title_translated: 关注重要信息：面向语言智能体的决策引导选择性世界建模
summary_translated: 强化学习为大型语言模型驱动的智能体提供了直接优化任务目标的机制，但任务奖励通常是稀疏的轨迹级信号，仅评估任务成败，未直接监督动作条件下的环境状态转移，导致模型对动作后果和环境动态缺乏明确理解。近期工作通过策略与世界建模联合训练引入辅助监督，但通常将完整的环境观测视为统一的世界建模目标，忽略了观测内容在决策中的不同相关性。我们提出DGS-WM（决策引导的选择性世界建模），一种面向语言智能体的决策引导型策略-世界建模联合训练方法。DGS-WM包含一个决策引导的观测选择组件，根据其对后续策略响应的支持程度，筛选具有决策价值的观测单元作为世界建模目标；以及一个置信度自适应加权组件，根据模型对所选目标的预测置信度动态调整监督强度。这两个组件共同构成一种决策感知的辅助世界建模损失，与同一策略模型上的RL损失联合优化。在涵盖单跳/多跳问答和交互式网页任务的多个基准测试中，DGS-WM在不同模型规模和RL算法下均实现一致改进，表现出比全观测世界建模方法更稳定、更有效的性能。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) hold broad knowledge in one set of weights, but lack interpretability and trustworthy reasoning, especially in high-stakes use cases. A neuro-symbolic model, with its interpretable architecture and System 2 reasoning capacity, is a promising alternative if built at the scale of LLMs; however, its symbolic backbone is usually constructed with human effort, so existing neuro-symbolic models are bottlenecked by the scope of the symbol component and usually domain-specific. A data-driven method could instead build a larger symbolic system by aligning and merging existing ones. We target its first, foundational step: matching units across these heterogeneous systems. Our method, SAE-IDF, encodes a symbol in its native context into a sparse code with a sparse autoencoder (SAE), re-weights each dimension by its rarity and matches across systems. On 12 tasks across 6 kinds of symbolic system, SAE-IDF outperforms the same LLM's dense baseline on all tasks with Gemma-2-9B and all but one with Llama-3.1-8B, by up to 45 points, consistently across SAE layers and configurations. SAE-IDF is also interpretable: every dimension of the sparse code has a human-readable meaning, so each match decomposes into named concepts (features). Our work paves the way to a universal symbolic backbone.
title: Sparse Autoencoders Are a Shared Coordinate System for Symbolic Matching
title_translated: 稀疏自编码器是符号匹配的共享坐标系
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）在一个权重集合中蕴含广泛知识，但缺乏可解释性和可信推理能力，尤其在高风险应用场景中。神经符号模型因其可解释架构和系统2推理能力，若能以LLM规模构建，将是极具前景的替代方案；然而，其符号主干通常依赖人工构建，导致现有神经符号模型受限于符号组件的范围，且通常局限于特定领域。数据驱动的方法可通过对现有符号系统的对齐与合并来构建更大规模的符号系统。我们聚焦其第一步——跨异构系统匹配单元。我们的方法SAE-IDF使用稀疏自编码器（SAE）将符号在其原生上下文中编码为稀疏代码，并通过维度稀有性重加权后进行跨系统匹配。在6类符号系统共12项任务上，SAE-IDF在Gemma-2-9B上优于同模型的密集基线，Llama-3.1-8B上除一项外也全面胜出，最高提升达45分，且在SAE各层和配置中表现一致。SAE-IDF还具备可解释性：稀疏代码的每个维度均有可读的人类含义，因此每次匹配均可分解为命名概念（特征）。本工作为通用符号主干的构建铺平了道路。

summary: In this work, we reframe agentic trajectories as paths through a shared embedding space of actions and environmental observations. We show that successful and failed rollouts of the same task separate in this space, with simple per-task discriminators predicting held-out rollout outcomes at up to 0.95 AUROC across three agent benchmarks and three policy models. To exploit this signal across tasks, we introduce Precog-RM, a transformer-based model that meta-learns a representation in which outcome prediction can be performed in a few-shot setting. We show that Precog-RM generalizes to unseen tasks and models, and gives confident predictions of trajectory success long before termination. Deployed as an early stopping controller for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on Tau2-Bench, Precog-RM cuts training FLOPs by up to 47.3\% while maintaining performance comparable to baseline GRPO.
title: Divergent Paths: Learning an Outcome-Predictive Representation of LLM Agent Trajectories
title_translated: 分歧路径：学习大语言模型智能体轨迹的成果预测表示
summary_translated: 本文将智能体轨迹重新构想为在动作与环境观测共享嵌入空间中的路径。我们发现，同一任务的成功与失败轨迹在此空间中能够分离，通过简单的每任务判别器可在三个智能体基准和三种策略模型上实现高达0.95 AUROC的未见轨迹结果预测。为利用跨任务的这一信号，我们提出Precog-RM，一种基于Transformer的元学习模型，其在少样本设置下可进行成果预测。实验表明，Precog-RM能泛化至未见过的任务和模型，并在任务终止前长时间给出对轨迹成功性的置信预测。将其部署为Tau2-Bench上Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）的早期停止控制器时，Precog-RM最多可减少47.3%的训练浮点运算量，同时保持与基线GRPO相当的性能。

summary: Counts of which brands a large language model names are useful only if they hold long enough to act on. We test this with a pre-registered replication. The same 162 requests (54 questions in English, Estonian and Finnish about three software categories, four of twelve candidate brands per question, three repeats) were sent to gemini-3.1-pro-preview in three waves within about ten hours on 22 and 23 September 2026, and again on 13 October 2026, 20.3 days after the third wave, with identical request bodies. The plan and its decision rule were frozen, hashed and registered on OSF before the first call. The outcome is a lexical mention label per answer and brand, 648 per wave. The primary forecast, each brand-and-question cell's mention rate over the nine earlier answers, scored Brier 0.0281 and log loss 0.126, against Brier 0.0259 for the six-answer forecast of the 8-hour wave and a registered ceiling of 0.0559. It beat brand history (0.104), the overall rate (0.234) and a constant 0.5 (0.250) on both scores and in all nine question families (exact sign-flip p = 0.0039), so durability holds under the registered rule. A forecast frozen from the first wave alone scored 0.0599, 0.0587 and 0.0604 at horizons of 1.5 hours, 9.6 hours and 20.7 days. Of the 202 cells unanimous in the 8-hour wave, 194 were unchanged at D1 and none reversed. The latest wave alone was nearly as accurate as the pooled history (Brier 0.0292; pooled lower in 5 of 9 families, p = 0.28). Every answer reported the requested model version, and none issued a search query although search was enabled. A blind human check of 96 labels agreed with the rule on 94; both disagreements were adjudicated as rater omissions, so after adjudication the rule matched on 96 of 96. The test covers one model, one interval and twelve known brands, and estimates no decay rate.
title: Twenty Days Later: A Pre-Registered Test of History-Based Forecasts of Brand Mentions in Gemini Answers
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Pre-registered at this https URL . Data: this https URL
title_translated: 二十天后：对Gemini回答中品牌提及的历史预测的预注册测试
summary_translated: 大型语言模型提及的品牌数量只有在持续足够长的时间以供采取行动时才具有实际意义。我们通过预注册的复制实验对此进行了检验。相同的162个请求（54个问题，涵盖英语、爱沙尼亚语和芬兰语，涉及三个软件类别，每个问题包含十二个候选品牌中的四个，每个问题重复三次）在2026年9月22日和23日约十小时内分三波发送至gemini-3.1-pro-preview，并于2026年10月13日再次发送，即第三次波次后的20.3天，请求内容完全相同。研究计划及其决策规则在首次调用前已在OSF上冻结、哈希并注册。结果为每答案和品牌对应的词汇提及标签，每波648个。主要预测为每个品牌-问题单元在前九个答案中的提及率，Brier得分为0.0281，对数损失为0.126，优于八小时波次的六次预测（Brier 0.0259），且超过注册上限0.0559。该预测在所有九个问题类别中均显著优于品牌历史（0.104）、总体率（0.234）和常数0.5（0.250）（精确符号翻转p = 0.0039），表明其持久性在注册规则下成立。仅使用第一波数据冻结的预测在1.5小时、9.6小时和20.7天的预测 horizon 上得分分别为0.0599、0.0587和0.0604。在八小时波次中一致的202个单元中，D1时有194个保持不变，无一反转。最新一波的预测精度几乎与合并历史相当（Brier 0.0292；在9个类别中有5个更低，p = 0.28）。所有回答均正确报告了所请求的模型版本，且未发出任何搜索查询（尽管搜索功能已启用）。对96个标签的盲法人工检查中，规则与人工判断一致94次；两次不一致经裁定均为评分者遗漏，因此经裁定后规则在96个样本中全部匹配。该测试覆盖一个模型、一个时间区间和十二个已知品牌，但未估计衰减率。

summary: Long-output inference in large language models suffers from severe KV cache memory and bandwidth bottlenecks. While KV cache quantization alleviates this issue, low-bit quantization (e.g., 2-bit) severely degrades model accuracy. Recent mixed-precision key-cache quantization methods mitigate this degradation by allocating higher precision to important key channels, but estimate channel saliency using only key statistics. Through attention logit perturbation analysis at the RoPE channel-pair level, we show that quantization errors in channel pairs with large query--key pair-norm products contribute significantly to logit variation. Based on this insight, we propose PN-Mix, a mixed-precision key-cache quantization method for RoPE-based decoder-only LLMs, which allocates higher precision to salient channel pairs identified once during the prefill stage and reused throughout decoding. Across standard reasoning, code-generation, and AIME benchmarks, PN-Mix with 2.26-bit average precision achieves comparable or better average accuracy than prior mixed-precision methods using 2.32--2.39 bits. Furthermore, in our Pareto sweep, PN-Mix degrades gracefully down to 1.5 bits, whereas the compared baselines exhibit sharper performance drops below 2.25 bits.
title: PN-Mix: Pair-Norm Guided Mixed-Precision Key Cache Quantization for Efficient Long-Output LLM Inference
title_translated: PN-Mix：基于成对归一化的混合精度键缓存量化以实现高效长输出大语言模型推理
summary_translated: 大语言模型在长输出推理中面临严重的KV缓存内存与带宽瓶颈。虽然KV缓存量化缓解了此问题，但低比特量化（如2比特）会严重降低模型准确性。近期的混合精度键缓存量化方法通过将更高精度分配给重要键通道来减轻这种退化，但其通道显著性估计仅依赖于键统计信息。通过在RoPE通道对层面进行注意力logit扰动分析，我们发现具有较大查询-键成对范数乘积的通道对的量化误差对logit变化贡献显著。基于此洞察，我们提出PN-Mix，一种面向基于RoPE的解码器-only大语言模型的混合精度键缓存量化方法，该方法在预填充阶段一次性识别显著通道对，并在整个解码过程中复用。在标准推理、代码生成和AIME基准测试中，PN-Mix以平均2.26比特精度实现了与先前混合精度方法（使用2.32–2.39比特）相当或更优的平均准确率。此外，在帕累托扫描中，PN-Mix可平滑降至1.5比特，而对比基线在低于2.25比特时性能急剧下降。

summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate text, their misuse has become a growing societal problem, with implications for academic misconduct, model distillation, and cyberattacks. For these reasons, Model Authorship Attribution (MAA), which identifies the source model of a given text, is important for promoting the responsible use of LLMs and improving AI safety. In practice, attribution systems must remain reliable beyond the distributions observed during training. They may encounter texts from unseen domains and writing settings, as well as generations from future versions of model families that were not available when the system was trained. However, existing MAA methods often exhibit substantial performance degradation under such distribution shifts. To address this challenge, we propose Authorship Tracing via Likelihood-based Attribution of Sources (ATLAS), which formulates MAA through source-conditioned text modeling rather than direct source prediction. ATLAS learns how text from each source family is generated and attributes a given text by comparing its likelihood under each learned source condition. We aggregate this likelihood evidence at the token level with clipping so that no single token dominates the decision. We further introduce MAABench, a broad MAA benchmark for evaluating practical OOD settings such as domain and version. Our experiments show that ATLAS consistently outperforms existing baselines across MAABench and OpenTuringBench. In particular, when both the generation domain and the model version change on MAABench, ATLAS achieves 74.27% accuracy, 9.00pp higher than the strongest baseline. Beyond MAA, ATLAS can also help identify distillation source models by measuring which source model a target LLM most closely resembles. Our extended experiments show that ATLAS recovers the known teacher of every distilled model we evaluate.
title: Who's Behind the Text? Robust Model Authorship Attribution
title_translated: 谁在背后写作？鲁棒的模型作者归属
summary_translated: 随着大语言模型（LLMs）被越来越多地用于文本生成，其滥用已成为日益严重的社会问题，涉及学术不端、模型蒸馏和网络攻击等。因此，模型作者归属（MAA）——即识别给定文本的来源模型——对于促进LLMs负责任使用和提升AI安全性至关重要。实践中，归属系统必须在训练分布之外仍保持可靠性，可能遇到未见领域、写作风格以及训练时不可用的未来模型版本生成的文本。然而，现有MAA方法在这些分布偏移下往往表现出显著性能下降。为应对这一挑战，我们提出基于似然的源归属的作者溯源（ATLAS），通过源条件化文本建模而非直接源预测来形式化MAA。ATLAS学习每类源家族如何生成文本，并通过比较给定文本在各学习源条件下的似然度来进行归属。我们采用截断方式在词元层面聚合似然证据，防止单个词元主导决策。我们进一步引入MAABench，一个广泛的MAA基准，用于评估实际的分布外（OOD）场景，如领域和版本差异。实验表明，ATLAS在MAABench和OpenTuringBench上始终优于现有基线。尤其在MAABench上，当生成领域和模型版本均发生变化时，ATLAS达到74.27%的准确率，比最强基线高出9.00个百分点。除MAA外，ATLAS还可通过测量目标LLM最接近哪个源模型来帮助识别蒸馏源模型。扩展实验显示，ATLAS成功恢复了我们评估的每一个蒸馏模型的已知教师模型。

summary: In long-horizon tool-calling tasks, LLM agents can fail not only because of tool-use errors, but also because of ineffective interaction with users. Yet existing benchmarks largely assume cooperative and behaviorally stable users, leaving the effect of emotional variation on agent reliability underexplored. We introduce $τ$-Emotion-Bench, a ten-domain benchmark for evaluating tool-calling agents under controlled emotion-conditioned user interactions while preserving the underlying task objective. To scale both benchmark construction and agent training, we introduce Tracer, a scalable agentic data-generation pipeline that constructs grounded, policy-valid tasks and collects trajectories through an interactive agent--user--environment harness. By allowing dissatisfied users to terminate inefficient interactions, the harness provides an interaction-aware signal that filters trajectories with excessive user dependence and favors effective tool use. Experiments with two user simulators show that frontier agents remain unreliable, with substantial gaps between average task success and consistent task completion. Tracer-generated supervision consistently improves Qwen3 models across scales, generalizes to unseen domains, and transfers to $τ$-Bench and $τ$-Trait. Behavioral analyses further show that higher task success is associated with a better balance between tool execution and necessary user follow-up. Overall, $τ$-Emotion-Bench and Tracer provide a scalable framework for evaluating agent reliability under diverse user behaviors and improving tool-calling agents through interaction-aware supervision.
title: $τ$-Emotion-Bench: Exposing the Interaction Fragility of LLM Agents through Real-World User Emotions
comment: Accepted to the UserSim Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
title_translated: $τ$-Emotion-Bench：通过真实用户情绪揭示大语言模型智能体的交互脆弱性
summary_translated: 在长周期工具调用任务中，LLM智能体的失败不仅源于工具使用错误，还可能由于与用户的无效交互。然而，现有基准大多假设用户是合作且行为稳定的，导致情绪变化对智能体可靠性的影响尚未得到充分探索。我们提出$τ$-Emotion-Bench，一个涵盖十个领域的基准，用于在受控的情绪条件用户交互下评估工具调用智能体，同时保留底层任务目标。为实现基准构建与智能体训练的规模化，我们引入Tracer，一种可扩展的智能体数据生成流水线，能够构建基于事实、策略有效的任务，并通过交互式智能体-用户-环境框架收集轨迹。通过允许不满用户终止低效交互，该框架提供了一种交互感知信号，过滤掉过度依赖用户的轨迹，偏好有效工具使用。使用两个用户模拟器的实验表明，前沿智能体仍不可靠，平均任务成功率与稳定完成率之间存在显著差距。Tracer生成的监督信号在不同规模的Qwen3模型上持续提升性能，可泛化至未见过的领域，并迁移至$τ$-Bench和$τ$-Trait。行为分析进一步表明，更高的任务成功率与工具执行与必要用户跟进之间的更好平衡相关。总体而言，$τ$-Emotion-Bench与Tracer提供了一个可扩展的框架，用于在多样化用户行为下评估智能体可靠性，并通过交互感知监督改进工具调用智能体。

summary: Verifiable instruction-following benchmarks emphasize output-constraint satisfaction but can overlook whether responses meaningfully answer the underlying request, creating an evaluation blind spot. We show that frontier models can receive full credit for responses with little substantive answer content. Using the same verifier-based criterion as a training reward can induce reward hacking, as publicly released checkpoints exhibit higher constraint satisfaction but lower response quality after reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. To address this reward hacking, we introduce CALIF, a lightweight method that augments verifier rewards with a calibrated likelihood-based bonus to preserve response quality. CALIF evaluates response likelihood under the request alone using the existing frozen reference policy, requiring no additional judge or learned reward model. Across models ranging from 1.7B to 8B in reasoning and non-reasoning modes, CALIF improves constraint satisfaction on IFBench while maintaining response quality near or above pre-RL levels. It also outperforms corresponding base policies in 40 of 45 model-metric comparisons across three rubric-based instruction-following benchmarks, demonstrating gains beyond training verifiers.
title: Diagnosing and Correcting Reward Hacking in Verifiable Instruction Following
title_translated: 诊断并纠正可验证指令遵循中的奖励黑客问题
summary_translated: 可验证指令遵循基准强调输出约束的满足，但可能忽略响应是否真正回答了底层请求，从而造成评估盲点。我们发现前沿模型即使回应内容极少也能获得满分。使用与训练奖励相同的验证器标准可能导致奖励黑客现象，因为公开发布的检查点在经过可验证奖励的强化学习后，虽然约束满足度更高，但响应质量反而下降。为解决这一问题，我们提出CALIF，一种轻量级方法，通过引入校准的概率奖励增益来增强验证器奖励，以保持响应质量。CALIF利用现有冻结的参考策略，在仅考虑请求的情况下评估响应概率，无需额外的评判者或学习到的奖励模型。在从1.7B到8B规模的推理和非推理模式模型中，CALIF在IFBench上提升了约束满足度，同时保持响应质量接近或高于强化学习前水平。它在三个基于评分标准的指令遵循基准中，45次模型-指标比较中有40次优于对应的基础策略，证明了其超越训练验证器的提升效果。

summary: Post-training often improves the performance of large audio-language models on audio understanding and reasoning benchmarks. However, these improvements may reflect adaptation to specific question formats, such as multiple-choice questions, rather than genuine advances in audio understanding and reasoning capabilities. To investigate what LALMs actually learn from post-training, we conduct controlled experiments that disentangle improvements in audio understanding from adaptation to specific question formats. Across different models and post-training methods, we find that much of the reported improvement persists even without informative audio, but largely disappears when the question format changes. These findings suggest that post-training often teaches models to exploit task-specific textual cues and answer patterns rather than developing generalizable audio understanding and reasoning capabilities.
title: What Does LALM Post-training Learn? Rethinking Audio Understanding and Reasoning Capabilities
title_translated: 后训练阶段LALM学到了什么？重新思考音频理解与推理能力
summary_translated: 后训练通常能提升大型音频-语言模型在音频理解和推理基准上的表现。然而，这些提升可能反映的是对特定题型（如多选题）的适应，而非真正的音频理解与推理能力进步。为探究LALMs在后训练中实际学到的内容，我们进行了受控实验，将音频理解能力的提升与对特定题型格式的适应性分离开来。在不同模型和后训练方法下，我们发现大部分报告的性能提升在没有有效音频信息时依然存在，但当题型格式改变时则基本消失。这表明后训练往往教会模型利用任务特定的文本线索和答题模式，而非发展出可泛化的音频理解与推理能力。

summary: Multimodal in-context learning (ICL) is an important capability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Its performance is closely tied to the demonstrations it uses, making demonstration retrieval a core problem for ICL. Common methods use fixed scoring methods to retrieve all the demonstrations at once, which may introduce redundancy and noise. Context-aware retrieval methods have emerged to address this problem by allowing incremental retrieval from a growing context. However, none of them lets the MLLM learn how to judge what new demonstrations it needs and then carry out progressive retrieval on its own. To this end, we introduce ActICL, which trains an MLLM agent to acquire and use an ICL context via tool-augmented reasoning. An ActICL agent analyzes its own information gaps during iterative reasoning and tool-use actions. Based on these gaps, it performs targeted retrieval to acquire a set of initial candidates. It can then use the existing context to further filter the candidates and refine the context, or it can iteratively perform a new retrieval. When the agent judges that the context is sufficient for the task, or when the resource limit is reached with the user request met, it sends the acquired context to an answering model, either the agent itself or another MLLM. We use a two-stage post-training procedure that jointly optimizes the agent's acquisition and answering. With an adaptive number of demonstrations, ActICL improves average performance by 11.6 percentage points over standard similarity-based retrieval across seven benchmarks and three MLLMs, and by 4.4 points compared to the strongest prior baseline. The contexts acquired by ActICL agents can also be used effectively by frontier models. When GPT-5.6-Sol performs 4-shot ICL, ActICL's contexts improve its performance by 3.5 points over standard retrieval, averaged over three benchmarks.
title: ActICL: Post-Training for Agentic Multimodal In-Context Learning
title_translated: ActICL：面向代理式多模态上下文学习的后训练方法
summary_translated: 多模态上下文学习（ICL）是多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的重要能力。其性能高度依赖于所使用的示范，因此示范检索成为ICL的核心问题。常用方法采用固定评分机制一次性检索所有示范，可能引入冗余和噪声。上下文感知的检索方法已出现，通过允许从不断增长的上下文中增量检索来缓解此问题。然而，目前尚无方法让MLLM自主学习判断需要哪些新示范，并主动进行渐进式检索。为此，我们提出ActICL，一种训练MLLM代理通过工具增强推理来获取并使用ICL上下文的方法。ActICL代理在迭代推理和工具使用过程中分析自身的信息缺口，基于这些缺口执行有针对性的检索以获取初始候选集。随后，它可以利用已有上下文进一步筛选候选、优化上下文，或迭代执行新一轮检索。当代理判断上下文已足够完成任务，或资源限制达到且用户请求已满足时，将获取的上下文发送给回答模型（可以是代理自身或其他MLLM）。我们采用两阶段后训练流程，联合优化代理的上下文获取与回答能力。在七个基准和三类MLLM上，ActICL以自适应数量的示范，平均性能比标准相似性检索高出11.6个百分点，比最强的先前基线高出4.4个百分点。ActICL代理获取的上下文也可被前沿模型有效利用。当GPT-5.6-Sol执行4次示例的ICL时，ActICL的上下文使其性能在三个基准上平均提升3.5个百分点，优于标准检索。

summary: Multimodal models and agents have emerged to enable AI systems to learn from and interact with the real world more like humans by integrating information across multiple modalities. However, enabling multimodal agents to continually acquire useful information from complex, heterogeneous multimodal data remains a significant challenge as they move toward long-horizon tasks and lifelong settings. Addressing this challenge requires effective memory mechanisms that can maintain continuity across sessions, adapt to changing users and environments, and refine memory-management policies through accumulated experience. We introduce a two-axis analytical framework for multimodal agent memory structured around two key questions: how multimodal information is formed and represented (Axis I, Formation and Representation), and how its management adapts with accumulated experience (Axis II, Memory Management). Axis I, Formation and Representation, characterizes what information is retained and how it is encoded (e.g., modality-specific embeddings, textual and structured records, latent and parametric representations) to support subsequent reasoning and action. Axis II, Memory Management, distinguishes three tiers: T1 Static Memory reuses fixed memory; T2 Dynamic Memory updates memory through a stable policy; and T3 Self-Evolving Memory updates memory through an evolving policy. Based on this framework, we synthesize recurring design patterns and derive principles for balancing source fidelity with abstraction, maintaining temporal validity and provenance, grounding memory use in recoverable evidence, and evolving memory policies over time. Furthermore, we discuss the challenges and potential future directions for the memory mechanism of multimodal agents.
title: Seeing, Maintaining, and Learning: The Evolution of Multimodal Agent Memory
title_translated: 看见、维持与学习：多模态智能体记忆的演进
summary_translated: 多模态模型与智能体的出现使AI系统能够更像人类一样从现实世界中学习并交互，通过整合多种模态的信息实现跨模态理解。然而，随着智能体向长周期任务和终身学习场景演进，如何持续从复杂、异构的多模态数据中获取有用信息仍是一个重大挑战。应对这一挑战需要有效的记忆机制，能够跨会话保持连续性，适应变化的用户与环境，并通过积累的经验不断优化记忆管理策略。我们提出一个双轴分析框架，围绕两个核心问题构建多模态智能体记忆：第一轴（轴I，形成与表示），关注多模态信息如何形成与表征；第二轴（轴II，记忆管理），关注其管理策略如何随经验积累而演化。轴I描述保留何种信息及其编码方式（如模态特定嵌入、文本与结构化记录、潜在与参数化表示），以支持后续推理与行动。轴II区分三个层级：T1静态记忆复用固定记忆；T2动态记忆通过稳定策略更新；T3自演化记忆通过演化策略更新。基于该框架，我们归纳出常见的设计模式，并提炼出平衡源真实性与抽象性、保持时间有效性与来源可追溯性、基于可恢复证据使用记忆、以及随时间演化记忆策略的原则。此外，我们还讨论了多模态智能体记忆机制面临的挑战与未来发展方向。

summary: Embodied visual tracking requires a robot to identify a designated target from visual observations and control its own motion to follow that target through an environment. Following an isolated person is a comparatively simple demonstration of embodied visual tracking, but following the intended person among distractors remains challenging. Existing methods exhibit a substantial drop in success from single-target to distractor tracking, motivating a focus on the shared spaces that person-following robots must navigate. We present \method{}, a vision--language waypoint policy built around the hypothesis that visual and language representations should be aligned before tracking-specific motion is learned. The policy combines complementary frozen visual encoders, multiscale temporal context, a transformer backbone, and a lightweight head for robot-centric waypoint prediction. Its training progresses through vision--language alignment, multimodal reasoning mid-training, and tracking specialization on 19,532 oracle episodes. Compared with 41.54\% distractor-tracking success for our earlier OmTrackVLA model, the complete multi-stage recipe achieves 55.80\%. We then explore on-policy refinement using filtered oracle labels for states visited by the policy. This preliminary study adds 2.42 percentage points of distractor-tracking success, reaching 58.22\%, while reducing collision rate by 1.99 pts. The final policy records the highest distractor- and ambiguous-tracking success rates among the compared methods. These results support staged multimodal learning as a promising direction for tracking among distractors and motivate further study of on-policy refinement for person following in shared spaces.
title: VLX-Go: Robust Embodied Tracking through Multi-Stage Learning and On-Policy Refinement
title_translated: VLX-Go：通过多阶段学习与在线策略精炼实现鲁棒的具身追踪
summary_translated: 具身视觉追踪要求机器人从视觉观测中识别指定目标，并控制自身运动在环境中跟随该目标。跟随一个孤立的人是具身视觉追踪的一个相对简单的范例，但在干扰物中跟随目标人物仍极具挑战。现有方法在单目标追踪到干扰物追踪时成功率显著下降，促使研究聚焦于人跟随机器人必须穿越的共享空间。我们提出	extmethod{}，一种基于视觉-语言路径点策略的方法，其核心假设是：在学习追踪特定运动之前，应先对齐视觉与语言表示。该策略结合了互补的冻结视觉编码器、多尺度时间上下文、Transformer骨干网络以及用于机器人中心路径点预测的轻量级头部。其训练过程分为三个阶段：视觉-语言对齐、多模态推理中期训练，以及在19,532个理想状态轨迹上的追踪专业化训练。相较于我们早期OmTrackVLA模型在干扰物追踪中41.54%的成功率，完整的多阶段方案达到了55.80%。随后，我们探索使用过滤后的理想标签对策略访问的状态进行在线策略精炼。初步研究表明，该方法使干扰物追踪成功率提升2.42个百分点至58.22%，同时碰撞率降低1.99个百分点。最终策略在对比方法中取得了最高的干扰物与模糊追踪成功率。这些结果支持分阶段多模态学习作为干扰物追踪的有前景方向，并激励进一步研究在线策略精炼在共享空间中的人物跟随任务中的应用。

summary: Activation steering adds a vector to a model's hidden states to control a named behaviour. A gain on that behaviour, however, does not show that the vector controls it directly: it may act through a component shared with neighbouring behaviours, which unsteered and random baselines cannot separate. We introduce the competing-target test: a vector is compared with the vector built the same way for a competing target, and an equivalence test states when their difference is below a useful margin. We apply it in open-weight models to vectors for Kantian deontology, which judges an act by the rule it follows, and act utilitarianism, which judges it by the welfare it produces. On held-out situations, prompting a framework raises its score and lowers the other's, whereas vectors for either framework move both scores alike, and none reaches the margin. The two vectors share most of their direction, a request to apply some framework; the same construction separates an optimistic from a pessimistic tone, whose vectors share much less. What a vector shares with its competitors therefore sets what it controls: steering a perspective can deliver a mixture, and measuring a disposition can measure its neighbours, unless tested against the competing target.
title: Steering Vectors for Competing Ethical Frameworks Are Interchangeable: A Competing-Target Test for Activation Steering
title_translated: 竞争伦理框架的引导向量具有可互换性：激活引导的竞争目标测试
summary_translated: 激活引导通过向模型的隐藏状态添加一个向量来控制特定行为。然而，行为表现的提升并不能证明该向量直接控制了该行为：它可能通过与邻近行为共享的组件起作用，而未引导和随机基线无法区分这一点。我们提出了竞争目标测试：将一个向量与其针对竞争目标以相同方式构建的向量进行比较，并在两者差异低于某个有用阈值时判定为等效。我们在开放权重模型中应用该测试，研究康德义务论（根据行为所遵循的规则判断其正当性）和行动功利主义（根据行为产生的福祉判断其正当性）的引导向量。在保留情境中，提示某一框架会提高其得分并降低另一框架的得分，而任一框架的引导向量却同时影响两个分数，且均未达到阈值。这两个向量在方向上高度重合，本质上是要求应用某种框架；相同的构造方法能有效分离乐观与悲观语气，但其向量方向重合度较低。因此，一个向量与其竞争者共享的内容决定了其控制范围：引导视角可能产生混合效果，测量一种倾向也可能反映其邻近倾向，除非与竞争目标进行对比测试。

summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) provides no reward-relative learning signal when all rollouts receive identical rewards. In long-horizon tasks that require multiple interactions, rewards are given only upon successful task completion, making all-fail groups common early in training and limiting opportunities to practice later steps. Guide Assisted GRPO replays a successful reference prefix before the learner continues. We study how initial positions, handoff units, and movement rules affect unassisted task completion. Across three model sizes on BFCL, starting near completion is more effective under a fixed turn-level threshold rule. Finer handoffs alone do not consistently help, but outcome-informed tool-call selection outperforms GRPO on trained and untrained task categories. Guided starts also improve AppWorld success on both evaluation splits. These findings highlight where learning starts and how starting positions move as key curriculum choices.
title: Where to Start, How to Move: Analyzing Curricula under GRPO for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Minchan Kim and Sungho Bae contributed equally
title_translated: 从何处开始，如何移动：基于GRPO的长时程LLM智能体课程分析
summary_translated: 组相对策略优化（GRPO）在所有轨迹获得相同奖励时无法提供相对奖励学习信号。在需要多次交互的长时程任务中，奖励仅在任务成功完成时给予，导致训练初期大量失败组普遍存在，限制了对后续步骤的练习机会。引导辅助GRPO在学习者继续前回放一次成功的参考前缀。我们研究了初始位置、交接单元和移动规则对无辅助任务完成的影响。在BFCL数据集上对三种模型规模的实验表明，在固定回合级阈值规则下，靠近完成位置开始更有效。仅采用更细粒度的交接并不一致地带来帮助，但基于结果感知的工具调用选择优于GRPO在训练过和未训练任务类别上的表现。引导起始也提升了AppWorld在两个评估划分上的成功率。这些发现强调了学习起点以及起始位置如何移动是关键的课程设计选择。

summary: A training-data quality gate changes both which examples survive within regions of the input space and how training mass is distributed across those regions, so a gate-versus-random comparison does not isolate these mechanisms. We introduce Counterfactual Gate-Support Decomposition (CGSD), a four-arm, budget-matched design that crosses gate eligibility with support distribution and decomposes the observed gate effect into within-support selection, between-support redistribution, and their interaction. The practical constraint is finite-pool realizability: we characterize mass and token-assembly conditions under which the required arms can be constructed, together with a support-extinction case in which the ordinary design is undefined. On Korean-English and Korean-Japanese retrieval, the mean within-support selection component is the only one that exceeds its calibrated null band (+29.7 and +5.6 holdout items; 30/30 positive replicates), decisively in Korean-English and marginally in Korean-Japanese; redistribution and interaction remain unresolved at the available power. The same pattern holds for a second, unrelated gate family -- a model-confidence threshold rather than a deterministic verifier -- judged against its own null (+27.3 items, 9/9 positive), so the result is not a property of one gate's mechanism. On a mathematics gate, zero-eligibility supports leave the ordinary design undefined at every budget, while the extended design is constructible only inside narrow budget bands that an exhaustive scan locates and that the natural operating point misses -- the assembly condition separating a property of the pool from a limitation of the packer. CGSD therefore returns a decomposition, a constructible-but-underpowered design, or an explicit non-constructibility result, and says which; it prevents support redistribution from being silently interpreted as sample-level gate quality.
title: Counterfactual Gate-Support Decomposition: Separating Selection from Redistribution in Training-Data Filtering
title_translated: 反事实门控支持分解：训练数据过滤中选择与再分配的分离
summary_translated: 训练数据质量门控不仅改变输入空间各区域中幸存的样本，还影响训练质量在这些区域间的分布，因此门控与随机对比无法隔离这两种机制。我们提出反事实门控支持分解（CGSD），一种四臂、预算匹配的设计，通过交叉门控资格与支持分布，将观测到的门控效应分解为支持内选择、支持间再分配及其交互作用。实际约束是有限池可实现性：我们刻画了在何种质量与标记组装条件下可构建所需各臂，以及支持灭绝情形下普通设计未定义的情况。在韩英和韩日检索任务中，支持内选择成分的均值显著超过校准零假设区间（+29.7和+5.6保留项；30/30正向复制），在韩英任务中具有决定性意义，在韩日任务中则边缘显著；再分配与交互作用在现有统计功效下仍无法确定。这一模式同样适用于另一类无关门控——模型置信度阈值而非确定性验证器——相对于其自身零假设（+27.3项，9/9正向），说明结果并非单一门控机制的特性。在数学门控中，零资格支持使得普通设计在所有预算下均未定义，而扩展设计仅在狭窄预算区间内可构建，需穷举扫描定位，且自然运行点恰好错过——这揭示了池属性与打包器局限之间的区别。因此，CGSD返回分解结果、可构建但功效不足的设计或明确的不可构建性结论，并予以说明；它防止支持再分配被无声解读为样本级门控质量。

summary: Assigning routine tasks to cheaper large language model (LLM) providers can reduce generation cost, but switching providers may require processing accumulated context again. Keeping dependent tasks with the same provider can instead reuse eligible context. Graph-based workflows therefore couple routing decisions across tasks. Independent providers may also privately know their real-time unit costs and strategically misreport them. We formulate this routing problem as a single-parameter procurement auction and propose STAR (Strategy-proof Topology-aware Agent Routing), which minimizes virtual-cost-weighted graph workloads. Its allocation rule and payments, computed by integrating workload over possible cost reports, make truthful reporting utility-maximizing regardless of other providers' reports and cover each truthful provider's execution cost. With independent cost distributions and non-decreasing virtual costs, STAR additionally minimizes the user's expected total payment to providers. Controlled synthetic experiments separate the execution-cost benefit of topology awareness from the payment benefit of virtual-cost optimization: the former grows with fan-out and transferred payload, while the latter increases gradually along the tested prior-shape heterogeneity path. A paired sensitivity study quantifies how payment savings vary with prior misspecification while strategy-proofness is preserved.
title: Truthful and Expected-Payment-Optimal Model Routing in Graph-Based Agentic Workflows
title_translated: 图式智能体工作流中的诚实且期望支付最优模型路由
summary_translated: 将常规任务分配给成本更低的大语言模型（LLM）提供商可降低生成成本，但切换提供商可能需要重新处理累积上下文。保持依赖任务与同一提供商绑定，则可复用符合条件的上下文。因此，图式工作流将任务间的路由决策耦合起来。独立提供商也可能私密知晓其实时单位成本，并战略性地虚报。我们将此路由问题建模为单参数采购拍卖，提出STAR（策略无关拓扑感知代理路由），旨在最小化虚拟成本加权的图工作负载。其分配规则与支付计算通过集成可能的成本报告来实现，使真实报告成为每个提供商的效用最大化策略，无论其他提供商如何报告，并覆盖每个诚实提供商的执行成本。在独立成本分布和非递减虚拟成本条件下，STAR还最小化用户对提供商的期望总支付。受控合成实验将拓扑感知带来的执行成本收益与虚拟成本优化带来的支付收益分离开来：前者随扇出和传输负载增长，后者则沿测试先验形状异质路径逐步增加。配对敏感性研究量化了在先验误设情况下支付节省的变化，同时保持策略无关性。

summary: Compute cost in automated essay scoring (AES) is usually treated as a technical efficiency issue rather than a measurement design concern. Yet deployment decisions require more than reporting latency, model size, or inference expense. In high-stakes settings, total burden includes validation, monitoring, adjudication, compliance, and governance; in instructional settings, pricing, licensing, and integration may dominate cost. This paper reframes AES as a cost-constrained measurement system and introduces the Cost-Aware Measurement Design (CAMD) Framework, a four-layer structure consisting of metering, allocation, unit economics, and decision, for translating computational and workflow resource records into decision-relevant cost constructs. Direct cost is specified as monetary outlay plus attributable labor and time, and two criteria, design attribution and auditability, determine what the cost boundary excludes. Burdens that satisfy neither criterion, such as institutional capability and governance posture, are represented as constraints on which designs are admissible rather than priced. The paper defines cost per defensible score (CPDS) and argues that AES systems should be compared by quality-cost sufficiency: minimizing cost among defensible scoring designs that satisfy measurement requirements. Scoring volume conditions all four layers, so cost per defensible score is treated as a function of scale rather than as a single transferable number. CAMD provides a portable basis for representing, comparing, and evaluating cost across AES studies and deployment contexts.
title: From Efficiency to Sufficiency: The Cost-Aware Measurement Design Framework for Automated Essay Scoring
title_translated: 从效率到充分性：面向自动作文评分的成本感知测量设计框架
summary_translated: 在自动作文评分（AES）中，计算成本通常被视为技术效率问题，而非测量设计关注点。然而，部署决策需要超越延迟、模型大小或推理开销的报告。在高风险场景中，总负担包括验证、监控、裁决、合规与治理；在教学场景中，定价、许可与集成成本可能占据主导地位。本文将AES重构为成本约束的测量系统，引入成本感知测量设计（CAMD）框架，该框架由计量、分配、单位经济与决策四个层级构成，用于将计算与工作流资源记录转化为决策相关的成本结构。直接成本定义为货币支出加上可归因的人力与时间成本，两个标准——设计归因与可审计性——决定成本边界排除的内容。不满足任一标准的负担（如机构能力与治理姿态）被表示为设计可行性的约束，而非定价对象。本文定义了可辩护评分的成本（CPDS），并主张AES系统应基于质量-成本充分性进行比较：在满足测量要求的可辩护评分设计中最小化成本。评分量影响所有四个层级，因此成本每可辩护评分被视为规模函数，而非单一可转移数值。CAMD为跨AES研究与部署情境的成本表示、比较与评估提供了可移植的基础。

summary: Online memes are often carriers of unsafe content such as disinformation and propaganda. Their rapid evolution in response to news events and strong dependence on contextual information make it difficult for platforms and moderators to detect and moderate them effectively. Moreover, existing moderation studies typically classify memes as safe or unsafe based on individual images, lacking the ability to perform broader provenance analysis, i.e., where a meme originates, how it spreads, what cultural symbolism it represents, whether it poses potential risks to society, etc. To bridge this gap, we introduce MemeTrace, a multimodal LLM-based agent that automatically traces the provenance and potential risks of emerging memes. We evaluate MemeTrace on Meme100, a dataset of 100 real-world memes, using both human annotation and automatic metrics. The results demonstrate that MemeTrace substantially outperforms the VLM baseline. More importantly, MemeTrace achieves higher accuracy in detecting unsafe memes, especially those involving disinformation and sensitive content, and remains robust under visual perturbations.
title: MemeTrace: A Multimodal LLM-Based Agent for Safety-Aware Meme Provenance Analysis
title_translated: MemeTrace：一种基于多模态大语言模型的安全感知表情包溯源分析智能体
summary_translated: 在线表情包常常携带不安全内容，如虚假信息和宣传内容。它们对新闻事件快速演变且高度依赖上下文信息，使得平台和审核人员难以有效检测和管理。此外，现有的审核研究通常仅基于单个图像将表情包分类为安全或不安全，缺乏进行更广泛溯源分析的能力，例如表情包的起源、传播路径、所代表的文化象征意义以及对社会可能带来的潜在风险等。为填补这一空白，我们提出了MemeTrace，一种基于多模态大语言模型的智能体，可自动追踪新兴表情包的溯源信息及其潜在风险。我们在包含100个真实世界表情包的Meme100数据集上对MemeTrace进行了评估，采用人工标注和自动指标相结合的方式。结果表明，MemeTrace显著优于视觉语言模型（VLM）基线。更重要的是，MemeTrace在检测涉及虚假信息和敏感内容的不安全表情包方面表现出更高的准确性，并在视觉扰动下仍保持鲁棒性。

summary: Many real-world questions demand not a single fact but an organized collection of them, yet existing factual knowledge benchmarks almost exclusively target single answer retrieval. We introduce ListQA, a benchmark of 9,045 human-curated, cross-validated questions (audited error rate of 1.7%) that require LLMs to recall multiple facts and compose them into structured lists of 3-10 elements. Questions range from flat lists ("Which NCAA teams went undefeated between 2000 and 2024?") to hierarchical lists with sub-attributes ("...and what was their record and result?"), spanning eight categories across 60+ countries. An evergreen design (explicit temporal constraints or historically immutable facts) keeps ground truth valid without periodic updates. For evaluation, we frame element matching as a linear sum assignment problem: optimal bipartite matching paired with LLM-based semantic grading jointly captures factual accuracy, hallucination, and format compliance. We benchmark 34 models (8 families, 42 configurations across standard and thinking enabled inference) and find: the best standard-inference model scores below 37% LLM-Judge-F1, multi-faceted questions are harder across the board, and providing the source Wikipedia page lifts scores dramatically, confirming that models can organize facts but struggle to retrieve them from parameters alone. Extended analyses cover base vs. instruction-tuned checkpoints and token efficiency. We release the dataset and evaluation code.
title: ListQA: A Benchmark for Evaluating List-Formatted Factual Knowledge Retrieval in Large Language Models

title_translated: ListQA：评估大语言模型中列表格式事实知识检索的基准测试
summary_translated: 许多现实问题需要的不是单一事实，而是一组有组织的事实集合。然而，现有的事实知识基准测试几乎都专注于单答案检索。我们提出了ListQA，一个由9,045个经过人工筛选并交叉验证的问题组成的基准测试（审计错误率为1.7%），要求大语言模型回忆多个事实并将其组合成包含3至10个元素的结构化列表。问题类型涵盖从扁平列表（如“2000年至2024年间哪些NCAA球队保持不败？”）到带有子属性的层级列表（如“它们的战绩和结果是什么？”），覆盖60多个国家的八个类别。其持续更新设计（明确的时间约束或历史不变的事实）确保了真实答案无需定期更新。评估时，我们将元素匹配建模为线性总和分配问题：最优二分图匹配与基于大语言模型的语义评分相结合，共同捕捉事实准确性、幻觉和格式合规性。我们对34个模型（8个系列，42种配置，涵盖标准推理与思维增强推理）进行了基准测试，发现最佳标准推理模型的LLM-Judge-F1得分低于37%，多维度问题整体更难，提供源维基百科页面能显著提升得分，证实模型具备组织事实的能力，但独立从参数中检索事实仍存在困难。扩展分析还涵盖了基础模型与指令微调检查点的对比及token效率。数据集和评估代码已公开发布。

summary: Can AI agents carry out research on open scientific problems? We introduce Into the Unknown, a benchmark that provides an agent with a science paper along with a research direction to pursue and tasks it to write a follow-up paper. We work with scientists at US Department of Energy (DOE) national laboratories, who each contribute an unpublished follow-up direction from their own work together with the necessary conditions a submission must meet. While assessing the quality of a follow-up paper is challenging in general, using these conditions to form a rubric makes evaluation more tractable for research problems that have no reference answer. We have nine frontier agents write 15 follow-ups each, spanning quantum computing, plasma physics, computational chemistry, materials science, and scientific machine learning domains. None of the 135 submissions satisfies all the conditions, and 114 fail our integrity check, most often because the paper claims work that was never done or reports numbers that contradict the recorded evidence. Overall, agents readily produce papers that look like follow-ups, but none meets the standard of the domain scientist, leaving substantial headroom. Our code and data are publicly available.
title: Into the Unknown: Benchmarking AI agents on open scientific research problems
title_translated: 进入未知领域：在开放科学问题上对AI智能体的基准测试
summary_translated: AI智能体能否在开放的科学问题上开展研究？我们提出了“进入未知领域”基准测试，该测试向智能体提供一篇科学论文及一个研究方向，要求其撰写后续论文。我们与美国能源部（DOE）国家实验室的科学家合作，每位科学家贡献自己未发表的研究方向，并设定提交必须满足的必要条件。虽然总体上评估后续论文质量具有挑战性，但利用这些条件构建评分标准，使针对无参考答案的研究问题的评估更具可行性。共有九个前沿智能体各撰写了15篇后续论文，涵盖量子计算、等离子体物理、计算化学、材料科学和科学机器学习等领域。在135份提交中，没有一份完全满足所有条件，114份通过了我们的完整性检查失败，大多数是因为论文声称完成了从未执行过的工作，或报告的数据与记录证据相矛盾。总体而言，智能体能够轻松生成看似合理的后续论文，但均未达到领域科学家的标准，仍有巨大提升空间。相关代码和数据已公开。

summary: Code generation models are actively being used in professional and educational settings. However, the competence of large language models (LLMs) to generate algorithmically diverse code remains largely unknown. We propose the DivAlgo benchmark, a large-scale dataset constituting algorithmically diverse solutions to programming problems. We also introduce a lightweight similarity metric to enable large-scale evaluation. Our experiments across 24 modern code generation models found that uncontrolled model-generated code is significantly less diverse than human solutions (capturing ~31% of human diversity), and even the best diverse code generation strategy could achieve only ~70% of human diversity. Moreover, while it was possible to steer the models to generate solutions based on human strategies, they were unable to reproduce the diversity of the human solutions. These findings indicate the limitations of code generation models in capturing the algorithmic diversity humans exhibit, and that overexposure to model-generated code can narrow programmers' algorithmic vocabulary.
title: DivAlgo: A systematic evaluation of algorithmic diversity for code generation models
title_translated: DivAlgo：代码生成模型算法多样性系统性评估
summary_translated: 代码生成模型正被广泛应用于专业和教育场景。然而，大型语言模型（LLMs）生成算法多样化代码的能力仍 largely 未知。我们提出了DivAlgo基准测试，这是一个大规模数据集，包含编程问题的多种算法解决方案。我们还引入了一种轻量级相似性度量方法，以支持大规模评估。在24个现代代码生成模型上的实验表明，未经控制的模型生成代码在算法多样性上显著低于人类解决方案（仅捕捉约31%的人类多样性），即使最佳的多样化生成策略也仅能达到约70%的人类多样性水平。此外，尽管可以引导模型生成基于人类策略的解决方案，但它们无法复现人类解决方案的多样性。这些发现表明，代码生成模型在捕捉人类展现的算法多样性方面存在局限性，且过度暴露于模型生成的代码会缩小程序员的算法词汇范围。

summary: How well can a language model turn a large, incomplete and partly contradictory body of documents into a plan when no single correct answer exists? We introduce Mission Analysis (MA)-Bench, built on mission analysis, the first step of military operational planning, in which a staff reads the full situation and states the problem before anyone proposes a solution. Its 10 expert-built scenarios pair synthetic packets of ten to twelve documents with 1,257 expert-written pass/fail requirements, each containing information on their source, question type, and importance level. A reasoning-model judge grades each brief against the requirements without seeing the documents; it grades like a fifth credentialed planner, leaving a four-planner panel's agreement unchanged (Fleiss $κ$ 0.42 to 0.41), and a judge from a second provider reproduces the model ranking (Spearman 0.94). Across twenty frontier and open-weights models the best gets 62% of the rubric items right. Models are strongest on facts stated in the documents (58%) and weakest on judgments that must be inferred (33%), and six failures in ten are omissions rather than errors. MA-Bench grades the determinations, not the prose. We release the packets, rubrics, prompts, scorer and every graded brief with item-level verdicts.
title: MA-Bench: Measuring Operational Planning in Language Models
title_translated: MA-Bench：衡量语言模型在操作规划中的表现
summary_translated: 当面对大量不完整且部分矛盾的文档，且不存在单一正确答案时，语言模型能多好地将其转化为计划？我们提出了基于任务分析（Mission Analysis, MA）的MA-Bench，这是军事作战规划的第一步，即工作人员阅读全部情况并陈述问题，再提出解决方案。该基准包含10个专家构建的场景，每个场景配以10至12份合成文档包，以及1,257条专家编写的通过/失败要求，每条要求包含来源信息、问题类型和重要性等级。使用推理模型作为评判者，在不查看原始文档的情况下，根据要求对简报进行评分；其评分表现如同第五位持证规划师，与四人评审小组的一致性保持不变（Fleiss κ 0.42至0.41），另一提供方的评判者也重现了模型排名（Spearman 0.94）。在二十个前沿及开源权重模型中，表现最好的模型仅正确回答了62%的评分项。模型在文档中明确陈述的事实方面表现最强（58%），而在需推断的判断方面最弱（33%），且十次失败中有六次是遗漏而非错误。MA-Bench评价的是决策本身，而非行文表达。我们已公开文档包、评分标准、提示模板、评分器及每份经逐项判定的简报。

summary: Maintenance work orders are the largest written record of how industrial equipment fails, yet in most plants they are close to unusable for analysis. Short texts are abbreviated and misspelt, asset identity is buried in free text, work-type labels contradict the work described, and the fields that matter most for reliability (symptom, root cause, action taken) are usually empty. As a result, diagnostic knowledge stays with senior technicians and leaves when they do. We present Plant Memory, a system that applies technical language processing (TLP) to SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) exports and builds an ISO 14224-aligned maintenance ontology in which every extracted statement is a reified fact carrying a confidence score, the evidence it was read from, and a verification state. Extraction is rule-first, with an optional large language model (LLM) acting as a second reader whose disagreements raise a fact's review priority rather than overwrite it. Technicians verify facts through a review queue, answer targeted knowledge-gap questions where failures repeat without a recorded cause, and approve or reject ontology drift proposals when new terms appear. The resulting graph is served to people through a web application and to AI agents through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, so both query the same verified knowledge and every answer cites the work orders behind it. On a synthetic 12-month export of 400 work orders from a parboiled-rice plant, rule-based extraction reaches 96.2% component accuracy, 88.9% failure-mode accuracy and 100% root-cause precision at 62% coverage; on 28 diagnostic questions, ranked root causes from the ontology are correct at top-1 in 82.1% of cases against 53.6% for the raw SAP root-cause column.
title: Plant Memory: Technical Language Processing and a Verified Maintenance Ontology for Agent-Accessible Failure Knowledge from SAP PM Work Orders

title_translated: 工厂记忆：面向智能体可访问的故障知识的技术语言处理与验证维护本体
summary_translated: 维护工单是工业设备故障最详尽的文字记录，但在大多数工厂中几乎无法用于分析。文本简短且拼写错误频发，资产标识隐藏在自由文本中，工作类型标签与实际工作内容矛盾，而对可靠性至关重要的症状、根本原因和采取措施等字段通常为空。因此，诊断知识仅保留在资深技术人员手中，并随其离职而流失。我们提出Plant Memory系统，通过技术语言处理（TLP）对SAP工厂维护（PM）导出数据进行处理，构建符合ISO 14224标准的维护本体，其中每个提取的陈述都作为带有置信度分数、证据来源和验证状态的实体事实。提取采用规则优先策略，可选大型语言模型（LLM）作为第二阅读者，其异议会提高该事实的审查优先级而非直接覆盖。技术人员通过审查队列验证事实，回答重复故障但无记录原因的知识空白问题，并批准或拒绝新术语出现时的本体漂移提案。最终构建的图谱通过Web应用供人查询，也通过模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器供AI智能体使用，两者均查询同一经验证的知识库，且每个答案均引用背后的工单。在来自一家大米加工工厂的合成12个月400个工单数据上，基于规则的提取达到96.2%的组件准确率、88.9%的故障模式准确率和100%的根本原因精确率，覆盖率为62%；在28个诊断问题中，本体生成的根因排名Top-1正确率达82.1%，远超原始SAP根因列的53.6%。

summary: Structured pruning reduces LLM inference costs by removing model components to produce smaller dense models. However, existing methods can cause reasoning performance to collapse on long-form reasoning tasks such as AIME. We propose \textit{LayerTrim}, a training-free structured pruning method that identifies redundant decoder layers and selectively trims their MLP features while preserving attention and decoder depth. LayerTrim is the first training-free structured pruning method designed to preserve long-form reasoning without gradients or recovery training. Across three reasoning language models and five benchmarks, LayerTrim outperforms existing structured pruning methods in most evaluated settings, improving average accuracy by up to 21.4 percentage points over RESP. On \texttt{Qwen3-14B}, LayerTrim achieves 1.24$\times$ faster prefill and 19.7\% lower peak GPU memory than the dense model, while better preserving reasoning ability. It also achieves the shortest average generation length among evaluated pruned models, while retaining the highest average accuracy. These results demonstrate that LayerTrim improves reasoning efficiency through both structural compression and reduced token generation.
title: Unlocking Structured Pruning for Reasoning Language Models via Attention-Preserving MLP Trimming
title_translated: 通过注意力保持的MLP裁剪解锁推理型大语言模型的结构化剪枝
summary_translated: 结构化剪枝通过移除模型组件以生成更小的密集模型来降低大语言模型（LLM）的推理成本。然而，现有方法在长篇推理任务（如AIME）上可能导致推理性能崩溃。我们提出LayerTrim，一种无需训练的结构化剪枝方法，能够识别冗余解码器层，并选择性地裁剪其MLP特征，同时保留注意力机制和解码器深度。LayerTrim是首个无需梯度或恢复训练即可保持长篇推理能力的无训练结构化剪枝方法。在三个推理型大语言模型和五个基准测试中，LayerTrim在多数评估场景下优于现有结构化剪枝方法，平均准确率提升最高达21.4个百分点，超过RESP。在Qwen3-14B上，LayerTrim实现1.24倍更快的预填充速度和峰值GPU内存降低19.7%，同时更好保留推理能力。它还在所有评估剪枝模型中实现了最短的平均生成长度，同时保持最高平均准确率。这些结果表明，LayerTrim通过结构压缩和减少token生成双重机制提升了推理效率。

summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been widely applied in embodied agents and robotics for vision tasks. However, MLLMs suffer from limitations in spatial reasoning and perception. Post-training techniques have shown promise for improving these capabilities; yet, there are limited data-driven surveys of such approaches. In this survey, we consider approaches to fine-tuning pretrained MLLMs for spatial reasoning tasks, ranging from supervised to reinforcement learning, with an emphasis on the datasets used. We investigate themes of dataset construction, data modality and annotation, and evaluation of the resulting models. Based on these themes, we categorize research into three groups: dataset design, dataset construction and evaluation. We find four main methods for constructing fixed spatial annotations: rules and templates, LLM prompting, procedural generation, and human-in-the-loop. We also observe substantial variation in evaluation approaches, including different scoring methods, tolerance metrics, and benchmark types. Finally, we identify opportunities for future research in unified dynamic annotation, efficient spatial reasoning, standardization of evaluation, expanded spatial range, and human-centered spatial interactions.
title: Towards a Data-Centric Understanding of Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
